verses.web: The proverbs of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel:
verses.kjv: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel;

verses.web: to know wisdom and instruction; to discern the words of understanding;
verses.kjv: To know wisdom and instruction; to perceive the words of understanding;

verses.web: to receive instruction in wise dealing, in righteousness, justice, and equity;
verses.kjv: To receive the instruction of wisdom, justice, and judgment, and equity;

verses.web: to give prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young man:
verses.kjv: To give subtilty to the simple, to the young man knowledge and discretion.

verses.web: that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel:
verses.kjv: A wise man will hear, and will increase learning; and a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels:

verses.web: to understand a proverb, and parables, the words and riddles of the wise.
verses.kjv: To understand a proverb, and the interpretation; the words of the wise, and their dark sayings.

verses.web: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge; but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.
verses.kjv: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge: but fools despise wisdom and instruction.

verses.web: My son, listen to your father’s instruction, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching:
verses.kjv: My son, hear the instruction of thy father, and forsake not the law of thy mother:

verses.web: for they will be a garland to grace your head, and chains around your neck.
verses.kjv: For they shall be an ornament of grace unto thy head, and chains about thy neck.

verses.web: My son, if sinners entice you, don’t consent.
verses.kjv: My son, if sinners entice thee, consent thou not.

verses.web: If they say, “Come with us, Let’s lay in wait for blood; let’s lurk secretly for the innocent without cause;
verses.kjv: If they say, Come with us, let us lay wait for blood, let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause:

verses.web: let’s swallow them up alive like Sheol, and whole, like those who go down into the pit.
verses.kjv: Let us swallow them up alive as the grave; and whole, as those that go down into the pit:

verses.web: We’ll find all valuable wealth. We’ll fill our houses with plunder.
verses.kjv: We shall find all precious substance, we shall fill our houses with spoil:

verses.web: You shall cast your lot among us. We’ll all have one purse.”
verses.kjv: Cast in thy lot among us; let us all have one purse:

verses.web: My son, don’t walk on the path with them. Keep your foot from their path,
verses.kjv: My son, walk not thou in the way with them; refrain thy foot from their path:

verses.web: for their feet run to evil. They hurry to shed blood.
verses.kjv: For their feet run to evil, and make haste to shed blood.

verses.web: For in vain is the net spread in the sight of any bird:
verses.kjv: Surely in vain the net is spread in the sight of any bird.

verses.web: but these lay wait for their own blood. They lurk secretly for their own lives.
verses.kjv: And they lay wait for their own blood; they lurk privily for their own lives.

verses.web: So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain. It takes away the life of its owners.
verses.kjv: So are the ways of every one that is greedy of gain; which taketh away the life of the owners thereof.

verses.web: Wisdom calls aloud in the street. She utters her voice in the public squares.
verses.kjv: Wisdom crieth without; she uttereth her voice in the streets:

verses.web: She calls at the head of noisy places. At the entrance of the city gates, she utters her words:
verses.kjv: She crieth in the chief place of concourse, in the openings of the gates: in the city she uttereth her words, saying,

verses.web: “How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools hate knowledge?
verses.kjv: How long, ye simple ones, will ye love simplicity? and the scorners delight in their scorning, and fools hate knowledge?

verses.web: Turn at my reproof. Behold, I will pour out my spirit on you. I will make known my words to you.
verses.kjv: Turn you at my reproof: behold, I will pour out my spirit unto you, I will make known my words unto you.

verses.web: Because I have called, and you have refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no one has paid attention;
verses.kjv: Because I have called, and ye refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no man regarded;

verses.web: but you have ignored all my counsel, and wanted none of my reproof;
verses.kjv: But ye have set at nought all my counsel, and would none of my reproof:

verses.web: I also will laugh at your disaster. I will mock when calamity overtakes you;
verses.kjv: I also will laugh at your calamity; I will mock when your fear cometh;

verses.web: when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when your disaster comes on like a whirlwind; when distress and anguish come on you.
verses.kjv: When your fear cometh as desolation, and your destruction cometh as a whirlwind; when distress and anguish cometh upon you.

verses.web: Then will they call on me, but I will not answer. They will seek me diligently, but they will not find me;
verses.kjv: Then shall they call upon me, but I will not answer; they shall seek me early, but they shall not find me:

verses.web: because they hated knowledge, and didn’t choose the fear of Yahweh.
verses.kjv: For that they hated knowledge, and did not choose the fear of the Lord:

verses.web: They wanted none of my counsel. They despised all my reproof.
verses.kjv: They would none of my counsel: they despised all my reproof.

verses.web: Therefore they will eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own schemes.
verses.kjv: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own devices.

verses.web: For the backsliding of the simple will kill them. The careless ease of fools will destroy them.
verses.kjv: For the turning away of the simple shall slay them, and the prosperity of fools shall destroy them.

verses.web: But whoever listens to me will dwell securely, and will be at ease, without fear of harm.”
verses.kjv: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely, and shall be quiet from fear of evil.

verses.web: My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you;
verses.kjv: My son, if thou wilt receive my words, and hide my commandments with thee;

verses.web: So as to turn your ear to wisdom, and apply your heart to understanding;
verses.kjv: So that thou incline thine ear unto wisdom, and apply thine heart to understanding;

verses.web: Yes, if you call out for discernment, and lift up your voice for understanding;
verses.kjv: Yea, if thou criest after knowledge, and liftest up thy voice for understanding;

verses.web: If you seek her as silver, and search for her as for hidden treasures:
verses.kjv: If thou seekest her as silver, and searchest for her as for hid treasures;

verses.web: then you will understand the fear of Yahweh, and find the knowledge of God.
verses.kjv: Then shalt thou understand the fear of the Lord, and find the knowledge of God.

verses.web: For Yahweh gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.
verses.kjv: For the Lord giveth wisdom: out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding.

verses.web: He lays up sound wisdom for the upright. He is a shield to those who walk in integrity;
verses.kjv: He layeth up sound wisdom for the righteous: he is a buckler to them that walk uprightly.

verses.web: that he may guard the paths of justice, and preserve the way of his saints.
verses.kjv: He keepeth the paths of judgment, and preserveth the way of his saints.

verses.web: Then you will understand righteousness and justice, equity and every good path.
verses.kjv: Then shalt thou understand righteousness, and judgment, and equity; yea, every good path.

verses.web: For wisdom will enter into your heart. Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.
verses.kjv: When wisdom entereth into thine heart, and knowledge is pleasant unto thy soul;

verses.web: Discretion will watch over you. Understanding will keep you,
verses.kjv: Discretion shall preserve thee, understanding shall keep thee:

verses.web: to deliver you from the way of evil, from the men who speak perverse things;
verses.kjv: To deliver thee from the way of the evil man, from the man that speaketh froward things;

verses.web: who forsake the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness;
verses.kjv: Who leave the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness;

verses.web: who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the perverseness of evil;
verses.kjv: Who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the frowardness of the wicked;

verses.web: who are crooked in their ways, and wayward in their paths:
verses.kjv: Whose ways are crooked, and they froward in their paths:

verses.web: To deliver you from the strange woman, even from the foreigner who flatters with her words;
verses.kjv: To deliver thee from the strange woman, even from the stranger which flattereth with her words;

verses.web: who forsakes the friend of her youth, and forgets the covenant of her God:
verses.kjv: Which forsaketh the guide of her youth, and forgetteth the covenant of her God.

verses.web: for her house leads down to death, her paths to the departed spirits.
verses.kjv: For her house inclineth unto death, and her paths unto the dead.

verses.web: None who go to her return again, neither do they attain to the paths of life:
verses.kjv: None that go unto her return again, neither take they hold of the paths of life.

verses.web: that you may walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.
verses.kjv: That thou mayest walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.

verses.web: For the upright will dwell in the land. The perfect will remain in it.
verses.kjv: For the upright shall dwell in the land, and the perfect shall remain in it.

verses.web: But the wicked will be cut off from the land. The treacherous will be rooted out of it.
verses.kjv: But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth, and the transgressors shall be rooted out of it.

verses.web: My son, don’t forget my teaching; but let your heart keep my commandments:
verses.kjv: My son, forget not my law; but let thine heart keep my commandments:

verses.web: for length of days, and years of life, and peace, will they add to you.
verses.kjv: For length of days, and long life, and peace, shall they add to thee.

verses.web: Don’t let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart.
verses.kjv: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee: bind them about thy neck; write them upon the table of thine heart:

verses.web: So you will find favor, and good understanding in the sight of God and man.
verses.kjv: So shalt thou find favour and good understanding in the sight of God and man.

verses.web: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.
verses.kjv: Trust in the Lord with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.

verses.web: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
verses.kjv: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.

verses.web: Don’t be wise in your own eyes. Fear Yahweh, and depart from evil.
verses.kjv: Be not wise in thine own eyes: fear the Lord, and depart from evil.

verses.web: It will be health to your body, and nourishment to your bones.
verses.kjv: It shall be health to thy navel, and marrow to thy bones.

verses.web: Honor Yahweh with your substance, with the first fruits of all your increase:
verses.kjv: Honour the Lord with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine increase:

verses.web: so your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will overflow with new wine.
verses.kjv: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, and thy presses shall burst out with new wine.

verses.web: My son, don’t despise Yahweh’s discipline, neither be weary of his reproof:
verses.kjv: My son, despise not the chastening of the Lord; neither be weary of his correction:

verses.web: for whom Yahweh loves, he reproves; even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.
verses.kjv: For whom the Lord loveth he correcteth; even as a father the son in whom he delighteth.

verses.web: Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.
verses.kjv: Happy is the man that findeth wisdom, and the man that getteth understanding.

verses.web: For her good profit is better than getting silver, and her return is better than fine gold.
verses.kjv: For the merchandise of it is better than the merchandise of silver, and the gain thereof than fine gold.

verses.web: She is more precious than rubies. None of the things you can desire are to be compared to her.
verses.kjv: She is more precious than rubies: and all the things thou canst desire are not to be compared unto her.

verses.web: Length of days is in her right hand. In her left hand are riches and honor.
verses.kjv: Length of days is in her right hand; and in her left hand riches and honour.

verses.web: Her ways are ways of pleasantness. All her paths are peace.
verses.kjv: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, and all her paths are peace.

verses.web: She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her. Happy is everyone who retains her.
verses.kjv: She is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her: and happy is every one that retaineth her.

verses.web: By wisdom Yahweh founded the earth. By understanding, he established the heavens.
verses.kjv: The Lord by wisdom hath founded the earth; by understanding hath he established the heavens.

verses.web: By his knowledge, the depths were broken up, and the skies drop down the dew.
verses.kjv: By his knowledge the depths are broken up, and the clouds drop down the dew.

verses.web: My son, let them not depart from your eyes. Keep sound wisdom and discretion:
verses.kjv: My son, let not them depart from thine eyes: keep sound wisdom and discretion:

verses.web: so they will be life to your soul, and grace for your neck.
verses.kjv: So shall they be life unto thy soul, and grace to thy neck.

verses.web: Then you shall walk in your way securely. Your foot won’t stumble.
verses.kjv: Then shalt thou walk in thy way safely, and thy foot shall not stumble.

verses.web: When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.
verses.kjv: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.

verses.web: Don’t be afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes:
verses.kjv: Be not afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it cometh.

verses.web: for Yahweh will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.
verses.kjv: For the Lord shall be thy confidence, and shall keep thy foot from being taken.

verses.web: Don’t withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in the power of your hand to do it.
verses.kjv: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the power of thine hand to do it.

verses.web: Don’t say to your neighbor, “Go, and come again; tomorrow I will give it to you,” when you have it by you.
verses.kjv: Say not unto thy neighbour, Go, and come again, and to morrow I will give; when thou hast it by thee.

verses.web: Don’t devise evil against your neighbor, since he dwells securely by you.
verses.kjv: Devise not evil against thy neighbour, seeing he dwelleth securely by thee.

verses.web: Don’t strive with a man without cause, if he has done you no harm.
verses.kjv: Strive not with a man without cause, if he have done thee no harm.

verses.web: Don’t envy the man of violence. Choose none of his ways.
verses.kjv: Envy thou not the oppressor, and choose none of his ways.

verses.web: For the perverse is an abomination to Yahweh, but his friendship is with the upright.
verses.kjv: For the froward is abomination to the Lord: but his secret is with the righteous.

verses.web: Yahweh’s curse is in the house of the wicked, but he blesses the habitation of the righteous.
verses.kjv: The curse of the Lord is in the house of the wicked: but he blesseth the habitation of the just.

verses.web: Surely he mocks the mockers, but he gives grace to the humble.
verses.kjv: Surely he scorneth the scorners: but he giveth grace unto the lowly.

verses.web: The wise will inherit glory, but shame will be the promotion of fools.
verses.kjv: The wise shall inherit glory: but shame shall be the promotion of fools.

verses.web: Listen, sons, to a father’s instruction. Pay attention and know understanding;
verses.kjv: Hear, ye children, the instruction of a father, and attend to know understanding.

verses.web: for I give you sound learning. Don’t forsake my law.
verses.kjv: For I give you good doctrine, forsake ye not my law.

verses.web: For I was a son to my father, tender and an only child in the sight of my mother.
verses.kjv: For I was my father’s son, tender and only beloved in the sight of my mother.

verses.web: He taught me, and said to me: “Let your heart retain my words. Keep my commandments, and live.
verses.kjv: He taught me also, and said unto me, Let thine heart retain my words: keep my commandments, and live.

verses.web: Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don’t forget, neither swerve from the words of my mouth.
verses.kjv: Get wisdom, get understanding: forget it not; neither decline from the words of my mouth.

verses.web: Don’t forsake her, and she will preserve you. Love her, and she will keep you.
verses.kjv: Forsake her not, and she shall preserve thee: love her, and she shall keep thee.

verses.web: Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes, though it costs all your possessions, get understanding.
verses.kjv: Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom: and with all thy getting get understanding.

verses.web: Esteem her, and she will exalt you. She will bring you to honor, when you embrace her.
verses.kjv: Exalt her, and she shall promote thee: she shall bring thee to honour, when thou dost embrace her.

verses.web: She will give to your head a garland of grace. She will deliver a crown of splendor to you.”
verses.kjv: She shall give to thine head an ornament of grace: a crown of glory shall she deliver to thee.

verses.web: Listen, my son, and receive my sayings. The years of your life will be many.
verses.kjv: Hear, O my son, and receive my sayings; and the years of thy life shall be many.

verses.web: I have taught you in the way of wisdom. I have led you in straight paths.
verses.kjv: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom; I have led thee in right paths.

verses.web: When you go, your steps will not be hampered. When you run, you will not stumble.
verses.kjv: When thou goest, thy steps shall not be straitened; and when thou runnest, thou shalt not stumble.

verses.web: Take firm hold of instruction. Don’t let her go. Keep her, for she is your life.
verses.kjv: Take fast hold of instruction; let her not go: keep her; for she is thy life.

verses.web: Don’t enter into the path of the wicked. Don’t walk in the way of evil men.
verses.kjv: Enter not into the path of the wicked, and go not in the way of evil men.

verses.web: Avoid it, and don’t pass by it. Turn from it, and pass on.
verses.kjv: Avoid it, pass not by it, turn from it, and pass away.

verses.web: For they don’t sleep, unless they do evil. Their sleep is taken away, unless they make someone fall.
verses.kjv: For they sleep not, except they have done mischief; and their sleep is taken away, unless they cause some to fall.

verses.web: For they eat the bread of wickedness, and drink the wine of violence.
verses.kjv: For they eat the bread of wickedness, and drink the wine of violence.

verses.web: But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light, that shines more and more until the perfect day.
verses.kjv: But the path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.

verses.web: The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don’t know what they stumble over.
verses.kjv: The way of the wicked is as darkness: they know not at what they stumble.

verses.web: My son, attend to my words. Turn your ear to my sayings.
verses.kjv: My son, attend to my words; incline thine ear unto my sayings.

verses.web: Let them not depart from your eyes. Keep them in the midst of your heart.
verses.kjv: Let them not depart from thine eyes; keep them in the midst of thine heart.

verses.web: For they are life to those who find them, and health to their whole body.
verses.kjv: For they are life unto those that find them, and health to all their flesh.

verses.web: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.
verses.kjv: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.

verses.web: Put away from yourself a perverse mouth. Put corrupt lips far from you.
verses.kjv: Put away from thee a froward mouth, and perverse lips put far from thee.

verses.web: Let your eyes look straight ahead. Fix your gaze directly before you.
verses.kjv: Let thine eyes look right on, and let thine eyelids look straight before thee.

verses.web: Make the path of your feet level. Let all of your ways be established.
verses.kjv: Ponder the path of thy feet, and let all thy ways be established.

verses.web: Don’t turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil.
verses.kjv: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left: remove thy foot from evil.

verses.web: My son, pay attention to my wisdom. Turn your ear to my understanding:
verses.kjv: My son, attend unto my wisdom, and bow thine ear to my understanding:

verses.web: that you may maintain discretion, that your lips may preserve knowledge.
verses.kjv: That thou mayest regard discretion, and that thy lips may keep knowledge.

verses.web: For the lips of an adulteress drip honey. Her mouth is smoother than oil,
verses.kjv: For the lips of a strange woman drop as an honeycomb, and her mouth is smoother than oil:

verses.web: But in the end she is as bitter as wormwood, and as sharp as a two-edged sword.
verses.kjv: But her end is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a twoedged sword.

verses.web: Her feet go down to death. Her steps lead straight to Sheol.
verses.kjv: Her feet go down to death; her steps take hold on hell.

verses.web: She gives no thought to the way of life. Her ways are crooked, and she doesn’t know it.
verses.kjv: Lest thou shouldest ponder the path of life, her ways are moveable, that thou canst not know them.

verses.web: Now therefore, my sons, listen to me. Don’t depart from the words of my mouth.
verses.kjv: Hear me now therefore, O ye children, and depart not from the words of my mouth.

verses.web: Remove your way far from her. Don’t come near the door of her house,
verses.kjv: Remove thy way far from her, and come not nigh the door of her house:

verses.web: lest you give your honor to others, and your years to the cruel one;
verses.kjv: Lest thou give thine honour unto others, and thy years unto the cruel:

verses.web: lest strangers feast on your wealth, and your labors enrich another man’s house.
verses.kjv: Lest strangers be filled with thy wealth; and thy labours be in the house of a stranger;

verses.web: You will groan at your latter end, when your flesh and your body are consumed,
verses.kjv: And thou mourn at the last, when thy flesh and thy body are consumed,

verses.web: and say, “How I have hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof;
verses.kjv: And say, How have I hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof;

verses.web: neither have I obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor turned my ear to those who instructed me!
verses.kjv: And have not obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor inclined mine ear to them that instructed me!

verses.web: I have come to the brink of utter ruin, in the midst of the gathered assembly.”
verses.kjv: I was almost in all evil in the midst of the congregation and assembly.

verses.web: Drink water out of your own cistern, running water out of your own well.
verses.kjv: Drink waters out of thine own cistern, and running waters out of thine own well.

verses.web: Should your springs overflow in the streets, streams of water in the public squares?
verses.kjv: Let thy fountains be dispersed abroad, and rivers of waters in the streets.

verses.web: Let them be for yourself alone, not for strangers with you.
verses.kjv: Let them be only thine own, and not strangers’ with thee.

verses.web: Let your spring be blessed. Rejoice in the wife of your youth.
verses.kjv: Let thy fountain be blessed: and rejoice with the wife of thy youth.

verses.web: A loving doe and a graceful deer— let her breasts satisfy you at all times. Be captivated always with her love.
verses.kjv: Let her be as the loving hind and pleasant roe; let her breasts satisfy thee at all times; and be thou ravished always with her love.

verses.web: For why should you, my son, be captivated with an adulteress? Why embrace the bosom of another?
verses.kjv: And why wilt thou, my son, be ravished with a strange woman, and embrace the bosom of a stranger?

verses.web: For the ways of man are before the eyes of Yahweh. He examines all his paths.
verses.kjv: For the ways of man are before the eyes of the Lord, and he pondereth all his goings.

verses.web: The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare him. The cords of his sin hold him firmly.
verses.kjv: His own iniquities shall take the wicked himself, and he shall be holden with the cords of his sins.

verses.web: He will die for lack of instruction. In the greatness of his folly, he will go astray.
verses.kjv: He shall die without instruction; and in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.

verses.web: My son, if you have become collateral for your neighbor, if you have struck your hands in pledge for a stranger;
verses.kjv: My son, if thou be surety for thy friend, if thou hast stricken thy hand with a stranger,

verses.web: You are trapped by the words of your mouth. You are ensnared with the words of your mouth.
verses.kjv: Thou art snared with the words of thy mouth, thou art taken with the words of thy mouth.

verses.web: Do this now, my son, and deliver yourself, since you have come into the hand of your neighbor. Go, humble yourself. Press your plea with your neighbor.
verses.kjv: Do this now, my son, and deliver thyself, when thou art come into the hand of thy friend; go, humble thyself, and make sure thy friend.

verses.web: Give no sleep to your eyes, nor slumber to your eyelids.
verses.kjv: Give not sleep to thine eyes, nor slumber to thine eyelids.

verses.web: Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.
verses.kjv: Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand of the hunter, and as a bird from the hand of the fowler.

verses.web: Go to the ant, you sluggard. Consider her ways, and be wise;
verses.kjv: Go to the ant, thou sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise:

verses.web: which having no chief, overseer, or ruler,
verses.kjv: Which having no guide, overseer, or ruler,

verses.web: provides her bread in the summer, and gathers her food in the harvest.
verses.kjv: Provideth her meat in the summer, and gathereth her food in the harvest.

verses.web: How long will you sleep, sluggard? When will you arise out of your sleep?
verses.kjv: How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard? when wilt thou arise out of thy sleep?

verses.web: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:
verses.kjv: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:

verses.web: so your poverty will come as a robber, and your scarcity as an armed man.
verses.kjv: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth, and thy want as an armed man.

verses.web: A worthless person, a man of iniquity, is he who walks with a perverse mouth;
verses.kjv: A naughty person, a wicked man, walketh with a froward mouth.

verses.web: who winks with his eyes, who signals with his feet, who motions with his fingers;
verses.kjv: He winketh with his eyes, he speaketh with his feet, he teacheth with his fingers;

verses.web: in whose heart is perverseness, who devises evil continually, who always sows discord.
verses.kjv: Frowardness is in his heart, he deviseth mischief continually; he soweth discord.

verses.web: Therefore his calamity will come suddenly. He will be broken suddenly, and that without remedy.
verses.kjv: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly; suddenly shall he be broken without remedy.

verses.web: There are six things which Yahweh hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:
verses.kjv: These six things doth the Lord hate: yea, seven are an abomination unto him:

verses.web: haughty eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood;
verses.kjv: A proud look, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood,

verses.web: a heart that devises wicked schemes, feet that are swift in running to mischief,
verses.kjv: An heart that deviseth wicked imaginations, feet that be swift in running to mischief,

verses.web: a false witness who utters lies, and he who sows discord among brothers.
verses.kjv: A false witness that speaketh lies, and he that soweth discord among brethren.

verses.web: My son, keep your father’s commandment, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching.
verses.kjv: My son, keep thy father’s commandment, and forsake not the law of thy mother:

verses.web: Bind them continually on your heart. Tie them around your neck.
verses.kjv: Bind them continually upon thine heart, and tie them about thy neck.

verses.web: When you walk, it will lead you. When you sleep, it will watch over you. When you awake, it will talk with you.
verses.kjv: When thou goest, it shall lead thee; when thou sleepest, it shall keep thee; and when thou awakest, it shall talk with thee.

verses.web: For the commandment is a lamp, and the law is light. Reproofs of instruction are the way of life,
verses.kjv: For the commandment is a lamp; and the law is light; and reproofs of instruction are the way of life:

verses.web: to keep you from the immoral woman, from the flattery of the wayward wife’s tongue.
verses.kjv: To keep thee from the evil woman, from the flattery of the tongue of a strange woman.

verses.web: Don’t lust after her beauty in your heart, neither let her captivate you with her eyelids.
verses.kjv: Lust not after her beauty in thine heart; neither let her take thee with her eyelids.

verses.web: For a prostitute reduces you to a piece of bread. The adulteress hunts for your precious life.
verses.kjv: For by means of a whorish woman a man is brought to a piece of bread: and the adulteress will hunt for the precious life.

verses.web: Can a man scoop fire into his lap, and his clothes not be burned?
verses.kjv: Can a man take fire in his bosom, and his clothes not be burned?

verses.web: Or can one walk on hot coals, and his feet not be scorched?
verses.kjv: Can one go upon hot coals, and his feet not be burned?

verses.web: So is he who goes in to his neighbor’s wife. Whoever touches her will not be unpunished.
verses.kjv: So he that goeth in to his neighbour’s wife; whosoever toucheth her shall not be innocent.

verses.web: Men don’t despise a thief, if he steals to satisfy himself when he is hungry:
verses.kjv: Men do not despise a thief, if he steal to satisfy his soul when he is hungry;

verses.web: but if he is found, he shall restore seven times. He shall give all the wealth of his house.
verses.kjv: But if he be found, he shall restore sevenfold; he shall give all the substance of his house.

verses.web: He who commits adultery with a woman is void of understanding. He who does it destroys his own soul.
verses.kjv: But whoso committeth adultery with a woman lacketh understanding: he that doeth it destroyeth his own soul.

verses.web: He will get wounds and dishonor. His reproach will not be wiped away.
verses.kjv: A wound and dishonour shall he get; and his reproach shall not be wiped away.

verses.web: For jealousy arouses the fury of the husband. He won’t spare in the day of vengeance.
verses.kjv: For jealousy is the rage of a man: therefore he will not spare in the day of vengeance.

verses.web: He won’t regard any ransom, neither will he rest content, though you give many gifts.
verses.kjv: He will not regard any ransom; neither will he rest content, though thou givest many gifts.

verses.web: My son, keep my words. Lay up my commandments within you.
verses.kjv: My son, keep my words, and lay up my commandments with thee.

verses.web: Keep my commandments and live! Guard my teaching as the apple of your eye.
verses.kjv: Keep my commandments, and live; and my law as the apple of thine eye.

verses.web: Bind them on your fingers. Write them on the tablet of your heart.
verses.kjv: Bind them upon thy fingers, write them upon the table of thine heart.

verses.web: Tell wisdom, “You are my sister.” Call understanding your relative,
verses.kjv: Say unto wisdom, Thou art my sister; and call understanding thy kinswoman:

verses.web: that they may keep you from the strange woman, from the foreigner who flatters with her words.
verses.kjv: That they may keep thee from the strange woman, from the stranger which flattereth with her words.

verses.web: For at the window of my house, I looked out through my lattice.
verses.kjv: For at the window of my house I looked through my casement,

verses.web: I saw among the simple ones. I discerned among the youths a young man void of understanding,
verses.kjv: And beheld among the simple ones, I discerned among the youths, a young man void of understanding,

verses.web: passing through the street near her corner, he went the way to her house,
verses.kjv: Passing through the street near her corner; and he went the way to her house,

verses.web: in the twilight, in the evening of the day, in the middle of the night and in the darkness.
verses.kjv: In the twilight, in the evening, in the black and dark night:

verses.web: Behold, there a woman met him with the attire of a prostitute, and with crafty intent.
verses.kjv: And, behold, there met him a woman with the attire of an harlot, and subtil of heart.

verses.web: She is loud and defiant. Her feet don’t stay in her house.
verses.kjv: (She is loud and stubborn; her feet abide not in her house:

verses.web: Now she is in the streets, now in the squares, and lurking at every corner.
verses.kjv: Now is she without, now in the streets, and lieth in wait at every corner.)

verses.web: So she caught him, and kissed him. With an impudent face she said to him:
verses.kjv: So she caught him, and kissed him, and with an impudent face said unto him,

verses.web: “Sacrifices of peace offerings are with me. This day I have paid my vows.
verses.kjv: I have peace offerings with me; this day have I payed my vows.

verses.web: Therefore I came out to meet you, to diligently seek your face, and I have found you.
verses.kjv: Therefore came I forth to meet thee, diligently to seek thy face, and I have found thee.

verses.web: I have spread my couch with carpets of tapestry, with striped cloths of the yarn of Egypt.
verses.kjv: I have decked my bed with coverings of tapestry, with carved works, with fine linen of Egypt.

verses.web: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
verses.kjv: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

verses.web: Come, let’s take our fill of loving until the morning. Let’s solace ourselves with loving.
verses.kjv: Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning: let us solace ourselves with loves.

verses.web: For my husband isn’t at home. He has gone on a long journey.
verses.kjv: For the goodman is not at home, he is gone a long journey:

verses.web: He has taken a bag of money with him. He will come home at the full moon.”
verses.kjv: He hath taken a bag of money with him, and will come home at the day appointed.

verses.web: With persuasive words, she led him astray. With the flattering of her lips, she seduced him.
verses.kjv: With her much fair speech she caused him to yield, with the flattering of her lips she forced him.

verses.web: He followed her immediately, as an ox goes to the slaughter, as a fool stepping into a noose.
verses.kjv: He goeth after her straightway, as an ox goeth to the slaughter, or as a fool to the correction of the stocks;

verses.web: Until an arrow strikes through his liver, as a bird hurries to the snare, and doesn’t know that it will cost his life.
verses.kjv: Till a dart strike through his liver; as a bird hasteth to the snare, and knoweth not that it is for his life.

verses.web: Now therefore, sons, listen to me. Pay attention to the words of my mouth.
verses.kjv: Hearken unto me now therefore, O ye children, and attend to the words of my mouth.

verses.web: Don’t let your heart turn to her ways. Don’t go astray in her paths,
verses.kjv: Let not thine heart decline to her ways, go not astray in her paths.

verses.web: for she has thrown down many wounded. Yes, all her slain are a mighty army.
verses.kjv: For she hath cast down many wounded: yea, many strong men have been slain by her.

verses.web: Her house is the way to Sheol, going down to the rooms of death.
verses.kjv: Her house is the way to hell, going down to the chambers of death.

verses.web: Doesn’t wisdom cry out? Doesn’t understanding raise her voice?
verses.kjv: Doth not wisdom cry? and understanding put forth her voice?

verses.web: On the top of high places by the way, where the paths meet, she stands.
verses.kjv: She standeth in the top of high places, by the way in the places of the paths.

verses.web: Beside the gates, at the entry of the city, at the entry doors, she cries aloud:
verses.kjv: She crieth at the gates, at the entry of the city, at the coming in at the doors.

verses.web: “To you men, I call! I send my voice to the sons of mankind.
verses.kjv: Unto you, O men, I call; and my voice is to the sons of man.

verses.web: You simple, understand prudence. You fools, be of an understanding heart.
verses.kjv: O ye simple, understand wisdom: and, ye fools, be ye of an understanding heart.

verses.web: Hear, for I will speak excellent things. The opening of my lips is for right things.
verses.kjv: Hear; for I will speak of excellent things; and the opening of my lips shall be right things.

verses.web: For my mouth speaks truth. Wickedness is an abomination to my lips.
verses.kjv: For my mouth shall speak truth; and wickedness is an abomination to my lips.

verses.web: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness. There is nothing crooked or perverse in them.
verses.kjv: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness; there is nothing froward or perverse in them.

verses.web: They are all plain to him who understands, right to those who find knowledge.
verses.kjv: They are all plain to him that understandeth, and right to them that find knowledge.

verses.web: Receive my instruction rather than silver; knowledge rather than choice gold.
verses.kjv: Receive my instruction, and not silver; and knowledge rather than choice gold.

verses.web: For wisdom is better than rubies. All the things that may be desired can’t be compared to it.
verses.kjv: For wisdom is better than rubies; and all the things that may be desired are not to be compared to it.

verses.web: “I, wisdom, have made prudence my dwelling. Find out knowledge and discretion.
verses.kjv: I wisdom dwell with prudence, and find out knowledge of witty inventions.

verses.web: The fear of Yahweh is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the evil way, and the perverse mouth.
verses.kjv: The fear of the Lord is to hate evil: pride, and arrogancy, and the evil way, and the froward mouth, do I hate.

verses.web: Counsel and sound knowledge are mine. I have understanding and power.
verses.kjv: Counsel is mine, and sound wisdom: I am understanding; I have strength.

verses.web: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.
verses.kjv: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.

verses.web: By me princes rule; nobles, and all the righteous rulers of the earth.
verses.kjv: By me princes rule, and nobles, even all the judges of the earth.

verses.web: I love those who love me. Those who seek me diligently will find me.
verses.kjv: I love them that love me; and those that seek me early shall find me.

verses.web: With me are riches, honor, enduring wealth, and prosperity.
verses.kjv: Riches and honour are with me; yea, durable riches and righteousness.

verses.web: My fruit is better than gold, yes, than fine gold; my yield than choice silver.
verses.kjv: My fruit is better than gold, yea, than fine gold; and my revenue than choice silver.

verses.web: I walk in the way of righteousness, in the midst of the paths of justice;
verses.kjv: I lead in the way of righteousness, in the midst of the paths of judgment:

verses.web: That I may give wealth to those who love me. I fill their treasuries.
verses.kjv: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance; and I will fill their treasures.

verses.web: “Yahweh possessed me in the beginning of his work, before his deeds of old.
verses.kjv: The Lord possessed me in the beginning of his way, before his works of old.

verses.web: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, before the earth existed.
verses.kjv: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, or ever the earth was.

verses.web: When there were no depths, I was born, when there were no springs abounding with water.
verses.kjv: When there were no depths, I was brought forth; when there were no fountains abounding with water.

verses.web: Before the mountains were settled in place, before the hills, I was born;
verses.kjv: Before the mountains were settled, before the hills was I brought forth:

verses.web: while as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the beginning of the dust of the world.
verses.kjv: While as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the highest part of the dust of the world.

verses.web: When he established the heavens, I was there; when he set a circle on the surface of the deep,
verses.kjv: When he prepared the heavens, I was there: when he set a compass upon the face of the depth:

verses.web: when he established the clouds above, when the springs of the deep became strong,
verses.kjv: When he established the clouds above: when he strengthened the fountains of the deep:

verses.web: when he gave to the sea its boundary, that the waters should not violate his commandment, when he marked out the foundations of the earth;
verses.kjv: When he gave to the sea his decree, that the waters should not pass his commandment: when he appointed the foundations of the earth:

verses.web: then I was the craftsman by his side. I was a delight day by day, always rejoicing before him,
verses.kjv: Then I was by him, as one brought up with him: and I was daily his delight, rejoicing always before him;

verses.web: Rejoicing in his whole world. My delight was with the sons of men.
verses.kjv: Rejoicing in the habitable part of his earth; and my delights were with the sons of men.

verses.web: “Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.
verses.kjv: Now therefore hearken unto me, O ye children: for blessed are they that keep my ways.

verses.web: Hear instruction, and be wise. Don’t refuse it.
verses.kjv: Hear instruction, and be wise, and refuse it not.

verses.web: Blessed is the man who hears me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at my door posts.
verses.kjv: Blessed is the man that heareth me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at the posts of my doors.

verses.web: For whoever finds me, finds life, and will obtain favor from Yahweh.
verses.kjv: For whoso findeth me findeth life, and shall obtain favour of the Lord.

verses.web: But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul. All those who hate me love death.”
verses.kjv: But he that sinneth against me wrongeth his own soul: all they that hate me love death.

verses.web: Wisdom has built her house. She has carved out her seven pillars.
verses.kjv: Wisdom hath builded her house, she hath hewn out her seven pillars:

verses.web: She has prepared her meat. She has mixed her wine. She has also set her table.
verses.kjv: She hath killed her beasts; she hath mingled her wine; she hath also furnished her table.

verses.web: She has sent out her maidens. She cries from the highest places of the city:
verses.kjv: She hath sent forth her maidens: she crieth upon the highest places of the city,

verses.web: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,
verses.kjv: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: as for him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,

verses.web: “Come, eat some of my bread, Drink some of the wine which I have mixed!
verses.kjv: Come, eat of my bread, and drink of the wine which I have mingled.

verses.web: Leave your simple ways, and live. Walk in the way of understanding.”
verses.kjv: Forsake the foolish, and live; and go in the way of understanding.

verses.web: He who corrects a mocker invites insult. He who reproves a wicked man invites abuse.
verses.kjv: He that reproveth a scorner getteth to himself shame: and he that rebuketh a wicked man getteth himself a blot.

verses.web: Don’t reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you. Reprove a wise man, and he will love you.
verses.kjv: Reprove not a scorner, lest he hate thee: rebuke a wise man, and he will love thee.

verses.web: Instruct a wise man, and he will be still wiser. Teach a righteous man, and he will increase in learning.
verses.kjv: Give instruction to a wise man, and he will be yet wiser: teach a just man, and he will increase in learning.

verses.web: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
verses.kjv: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding.

verses.web: For by me your days will be multiplied. The years of your life will be increased.
verses.kjv: For by me thy days shall be multiplied, and the years of thy life shall be increased.

verses.web: If you are wise, you are wise for yourself. If you mock, you alone will bear it.
verses.kjv: If thou be wise, thou shalt be wise for thyself: but if thou scornest, thou alone shalt bear it.

verses.web: The foolish woman is loud, Undisciplined, and knows nothing.
verses.kjv: A foolish woman is clamorous: she is simple, and knoweth nothing.

verses.web: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,
verses.kjv: For she sitteth at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,

verses.web: To call to those who pass by, who go straight on their ways,
verses.kjv: To call passengers who go right on their ways:

verses.web: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here.” as for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,
verses.kjv: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: and as for him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,

verses.web: “Stolen water is sweet. Food eaten in secret is pleasant.”
verses.kjv: Stolen waters are sweet, and bread eaten in secret is pleasant.

verses.web: But he doesn’t know that the departed spirits are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.
verses.kjv: But he knoweth not that the dead are there; and that her guests are in the depths of hell.

verses.web: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father; but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.
verses.kjv: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish son is the heaviness of his mother.

verses.web: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing, but righteousness delivers from death.
verses.kjv: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing: but righteousness delivereth from death.

verses.web: Yahweh will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry, but he thrusts away the desire of the wicked.
verses.kjv: The Lord will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish: but he casteth away the substance of the wicked.

verses.web: He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand, but the hand of the diligent brings wealth.
verses.kjv: He becometh poor that dealeth with a slack hand: but the hand of the diligent maketh rich.

verses.web: He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during the harvest is a son who causes shame.
verses.kjv: He that gathereth in summer is a wise son: but he that sleepeth in harvest is a son that causeth shame.

verses.web: Blessings are on the head of the righteous, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.
verses.kjv: Blessings are upon the head of the just: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.

verses.web: The memory of the righteous is blessed, but the name of the wicked will rot.
verses.kjv: The memory of the just is blessed: but the name of the wicked shall rot.

verses.web: The wise in heart accept commandments, but a chattering fool will fall.
verses.kjv: The wise in heart will receive commandments: but a prating fool shall fall.

verses.web: He who walks blamelessly walks surely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.
verses.kjv: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely: but he that perverteth his ways shall be known.

verses.web: One winking with the eye causes sorrow, but a chattering fool will fall.
verses.kjv: He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow: but a prating fool shall fall.

verses.web: The mouth of the righteous is a spring of life, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.
verses.kjv: The mouth of a righteous man is a well of life: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.

verses.web: Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all wrongs.
verses.kjv: Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins.

verses.web: Wisdom is found on the lips of him who has discernment, but a rod is for the back of him who is void of understanding.
verses.kjv: In the lips of him that hath understanding wisdom is found: but a rod is for the back of him that is void of understanding.

verses.web: Wise men lay up knowledge, but the mouth of the foolish is near ruin.
verses.kjv: Wise men lay up knowledge: but the mouth of the foolish is near destruction.

verses.web: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city. The destruction of the poor is their poverty.
verses.kjv: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city: the destruction of the poor is their poverty.

verses.web: The labor of the righteous leads to life. The increase of the wicked leads to sin.
verses.kjv: The labour of the righteous tendeth to life: the fruit of the wicked to sin.

verses.web: He is in the way of life who heeds correction, but he who forsakes reproof leads others astray.
verses.kjv: He is in the way of life that keepeth instruction: but he that refuseth reproof erreth.

verses.web: He who hides hatred has lying lips. He who utters a slander is a fool.
verses.kjv: He that hideth hatred with lying lips, and he that uttereth a slander, is a fool.

verses.web: In the multitude of words there is no lack of disobedience, but he who restrains his lips does wisely.
verses.kjv: In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin: but he that refraineth his lips is wise.

verses.web: The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver. The heart of the wicked is of little worth.
verses.kjv: The tongue of the just is as choice silver: the heart of the wicked is little worth.

verses.web: The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding.
verses.kjv: The lips of the righteous feed many: but fools die for want of wisdom.

verses.web: Yahweh’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.
verses.kjv: The blessing of the Lord, it maketh rich, and he addeth no sorrow with it.

verses.web: It is a fool’s pleasure to do wickedness, but wisdom is a man of understanding’s pleasure.
verses.kjv: It is as sport to a fool to do mischief: but a man of understanding hath wisdom.

verses.web: What the wicked fear, will overtake them, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.
verses.kjv: The fear of the wicked, it shall come upon him: but the desire of the righteous shall be granted.

verses.web: When the whirlwind passes, the wicked is no more; but the righteous stand firm forever.
verses.kjv: As the whirlwind passeth, so is the wicked no more: but the righteous is an everlasting foundation.

verses.web: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to those who send him.
verses.kjv: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to them that send him.

verses.web: The fear of Yahweh prolongs days, but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.
verses.kjv: The fear of the Lord prolongeth days: but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.

verses.web: The prospect of the righteous is joy, but the hope of the wicked will perish.
verses.kjv: The hope of the righteous shall be gladness: but the expectation of the wicked shall perish.

verses.web: The way of Yahweh is a stronghold to the upright, but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.
verses.kjv: The way of the Lord is strength to the upright: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.

verses.web: The righteous will never be removed, but the wicked will not dwell in the land.
verses.kjv: The righteous shall never be removed: but the wicked shall not inhabit the earth.

verses.web: The mouth of the righteous produces wisdom, but the perverse tongue will be cut off.
verses.kjv: The mouth of the just bringeth forth wisdom: but the froward tongue shall be cut out.

verses.web: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable, but the mouth of the wicked is perverse.
verses.kjv: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable: but the mouth of the wicked speaketh frowardness.

verses.web: A false balance is an abomination to Yahweh, but accurate weights are his delight.
verses.kjv: A false balance is abomination to the Lord: but a just weight is his delight.

verses.web: When pride comes, then comes shame, but with humility comes wisdom.
verses.kjv: When pride cometh, then cometh shame: but with the lowly is wisdom.

verses.web: The integrity of the upright shall guide them, but the perverseness of the treacherous shall destroy them.
verses.kjv: The integrity of the upright shall guide them: but the perverseness of transgressors shall destroy them.

verses.web: Riches don’t profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.
verses.kjv: Riches profit not in the day of wrath: but righteousness delivereth from death.

verses.web: The righteousness of the blameless will direct his way, but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.
verses.kjv: The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way: but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.

verses.web: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them, but the unfaithful will be trapped by evil desires.
verses.kjv: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them: but transgressors shall be taken in their own naughtiness.

verses.web: When a wicked man dies, hope perishes, and expectation of power comes to nothing.
verses.kjv: When a wicked man dieth, his expectation shall perish: and the hope of unjust men perisheth.

verses.web: A righteous person is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked takes his place.
verses.kjv: The righteous is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked cometh in his stead.

verses.web: With his mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor, but the righteous will be delivered through knowledge.
verses.kjv: An hypocrite with his mouth destroyeth his neighbour: but through knowledge shall the just be delivered.

verses.web: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices. When the wicked perish, there is shouting.
verses.kjv: When it goeth well with the righteous, the city rejoiceth: and when the wicked perish, there is shouting.

verses.web: By the blessing of the upright, the city is exalted, but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
verses.kjv: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted: but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.

verses.web: One who despises his neighbor is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding holds his peace.
verses.kjv: He that is void of wisdom despiseth his neighbour: but a man of understanding holdeth his peace.

verses.web: One who brings gossip betrays a confidence, but one who is of a trustworthy spirit is one who keeps a secret.
verses.kjv: A talebearer revealeth secrets: but he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter.

verses.web: Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls, but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.
verses.kjv: Where no counsel is, the people fall: but in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.

verses.web: He who is collateral for a stranger will suffer for it, but he who refuses pledges of collateral is secure.
verses.kjv: He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it: and he that hateth suretiship is sure.

verses.web: A gracious woman obtains honor, but violent men obtain riches.
verses.kjv: A gracious woman retaineth honour: and strong men retain riches.

verses.web: The merciful man does good to his own soul, but he who is cruel troubles his own flesh.
verses.kjv: The merciful man doeth good to his own soul: but he that is cruel troubleth his own flesh.

verses.web: Wicked people earn deceitful wages, but one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.
verses.kjv: The wicked worketh a deceitful work: but to him that soweth righteousness shall be a sure reward.

verses.web: He who is truly righteous gets life. He who pursues evil gets death.
verses.kjv: As righteousness tendeth to life: so he that pursueth evil pursueth it to his own death.

verses.web: Those who are perverse in heart are an abomination to Yahweh, but those whose ways are blameless are his delight.
verses.kjv: They that are of a froward heart are abomination to the Lord: but such as are upright in their way are his delight.

verses.web: Most certainly, the evil man will not be unpunished, but the seed of the righteous will be delivered.
verses.kjv: Though hand join in hand, the wicked shall not be unpunished: but the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.

verses.web: Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout, is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion.
verses.kjv: As a jewel of gold in a swine’s snout, so is a fair woman which is without discretion.

verses.web: The desire of the righteous is only good. The expectation of the wicked is wrath.
verses.kjv: The desire of the righteous is only good: but the expectation of the wicked is wrath.

verses.web: There is one who scatters, and increases yet more. There is one who withholds more than is appropriate, but gains poverty.
verses.kjv: There is that scattereth, and yet increaseth; and there is that withholdeth more than is meet, but it tendeth to poverty.

verses.web: The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself.
verses.kjv: The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.

verses.web: People curse someone who withholds grain, but blessing will be on the head of him who sells it.
verses.kjv: He that withholdeth corn, the people shall curse him: but blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it.

verses.web: He who diligently seeks good seeks favor, but he who searches after evil, it shall come to him.
verses.kjv: He that diligently seeketh good procureth favour: but he that seeketh mischief, it shall come unto him.

verses.web: He who trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous shall flourish as the green leaf.
verses.kjv: He that trusteth in his riches shall fall: but the righteous shall flourish as a branch.

verses.web: He who troubles his own house shall inherit the wind. The foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart.
verses.kjv: He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind: and the fool shall be servant to the wise of heart.

verses.web: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life. He who is wise wins souls.
verses.kjv: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life; and he that winneth souls is wise.

verses.web: Behold, the righteous shall be repaid in the earth; how much more the wicked and the sinner!
verses.kjv: Behold, the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth: much more the wicked and the sinner.

verses.web: Whoever loves correction loves knowledge, but he who hates reproof is stupid.
verses.kjv: Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge: but he that hateth reproof is brutish.

verses.web: A good man shall obtain favor from Yahweh, but he will condemn a man of wicked devices.
verses.kjv: A good man obtaineth favour of the Lord: but a man of wicked devices will he condemn.

verses.web: A man shall not be established by wickedness, but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
verses.kjv: A man shall not be established by wickedness: but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.

verses.web: A worthy woman is the crown of her husband, but a disgraceful wife is as rottenness in his bones.
verses.kjv: A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband: but she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones.

verses.web: The thoughts of the righteous are just, but the advice of the wicked is deceitful.
verses.kjv: The thoughts of the righteous are right: but the counsels of the wicked are deceit.

verses.web: The words of the wicked are about lying in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them.
verses.kjv: The words of the wicked are to lie in wait for blood: but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.

verses.web: The wicked are overthrown, and are no more, but the house of the righteous shall stand.
verses.kjv: The wicked are overthrown, and are not: but the house of the righteous shall stand.

verses.web: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom, but he who has a warped mind shall be despised.
verses.kjv: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom: but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised.

verses.web: Better is he who is lightly esteemed, and has a servant, than he who honors himself, and lacks bread.
verses.kjv: He that is despised, and hath a servant, is better than he that honoureth himself, and lacketh bread.

verses.web: A righteous man respects the life of his animal, but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.
verses.kjv: A righteous man regardeth the life of his beast: but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.

verses.web: He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread, but he who chases fantasies is void of understanding.
verses.kjv: He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread: but he that followeth vain persons is void of understanding.

verses.web: The wicked desires the plunder of evil men, but the root of the righteous flourishes.
verses.kjv: The wicked desireth the net of evil men: but the root of the righteous yieldeth fruit.

verses.web: An evil man is trapped by sinfulness of lips, but the righteous shall come out of trouble.
verses.kjv: The wicked is snared by the transgression of his lips: but the just shall come out of trouble.

verses.web: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth. The work of a man’s hands shall be rewarded to him.
verses.kjv: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth: and the recompence of a man’s hands shall be rendered unto him.

verses.web: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but he who is wise listens to counsel.
verses.kjv: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes: but he that hearkeneth unto counsel is wise.

verses.web: A fool shows his annoyance the same day, but one who overlooks an insult is prudent.
verses.kjv: A fool’s wrath is presently known: but a prudent man covereth shame.

verses.web: He who is truthful testifies honestly, but a false witness lies.
verses.kjv: He that speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness: but a false witness deceit.

verses.web: There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.
verses.kjv: There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword: but the tongue of the wise is health.

verses.web: Truth’s lips will be established forever, but a lying tongue is only momentary.
verses.kjv: The lip of truth shall be established for ever: but a lying tongue is but for a moment.

verses.web: Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil, but joy comes to the promoters of peace.
verses.kjv: Deceit is in the heart of them that imagine evil: but to the counsellors of peace is joy.

verses.web: No mischief shall happen to the righteous, but the wicked shall be filled with evil.
verses.kjv: There shall no evil happen to the just: but the wicked shall be filled with mischief.

verses.web: Lying lips are an abomination to Yahweh, but those who do the truth are his delight.
verses.kjv: Lying lips are abomination to the Lord: but they that deal truly are his delight.

verses.web: A prudent man keeps his knowledge, but the hearts of fools proclaim foolishness.
verses.kjv: A prudent man concealeth knowledge: but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.

verses.web: The hands of the diligent ones shall rule, but laziness ends in slave labor.
verses.kjv: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule: but the slothful shall be under tribute.

verses.web: Anxiety in a man’s heart weighs it down, but a kind word makes it glad.
verses.kjv: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad.

verses.web: A righteous person is cautious in friendship, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.
verses.kjv: The righteous is more excellent than his neighbour: but the way of the wicked seduceth them.

verses.web: The slothful man doesn’t roast his game, but the possessions of diligent men are prized.
verses.kjv: The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting: but the substance of a diligent man is precious.

verses.web: In the way of righteousness is life; in its path there is no death.
verses.kjv: In the way of righteousness is life; and in the pathway thereof there is no death.

verses.web: A wise son listens to his father’s instruction, but a scoffer doesn’t listen to rebuke.
verses.kjv: A wise son heareth his father’s instruction: but a scorner heareth not rebuke.

verses.web: By the fruit of his lips, a man enjoys good things; but the unfaithful crave violence.
verses.kjv: A man shall eat good by the fruit of his mouth: but the soul of the transgressors shall eat violence.

verses.web: He who guards his mouth guards his soul. One who opens wide his lips comes to ruin.
verses.kjv: He that keepeth his mouth keepeth his life: but he that openeth wide his lips shall have destruction.

verses.web: The soul of the sluggard desires, and has nothing, but the desire of the diligent shall be fully satisfied.
verses.kjv: The soul of the sluggard desireth, and hath nothing: but the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.

verses.web: A righteous man hates lies, but a wicked man brings shame and disgrace.
verses.kjv: A righteous man hateth lying: but a wicked man is loathsome, and cometh to shame.

verses.web: Righteousness guards the way of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.
verses.kjv: Righteousness keepeth him that is upright in the way: but wickedness overthroweth the sinner.

verses.web: There are some who pretend to be rich, yet have nothing. There are some who pretend to be poor, yet have great wealth.
verses.kjv: There is that maketh himself rich, yet hath nothing: there is that maketh himself poor, yet hath great riches.

verses.web: The ransom of a man’s life is his riches, but the poor hear no threats.
verses.kjv: The ransom of a man’s life are his riches: but the poor heareth not rebuke.

verses.web: The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.
verses.kjv: The light of the righteous rejoiceth: but the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.

verses.web: Pride only breeds quarrels, but with ones who take advice is wisdom.
verses.kjv: Only by pride cometh contention: but with the well advised is wisdom.

verses.web: Wealth gained dishonestly dwindles away, but he who gathers by hand makes it grow.
verses.kjv: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished: but he that gathereth by labour shall increase.

verses.web: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but when longing is fulfilled, it is a tree of life.
verses.kjv: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick: but when the desire cometh, it is a tree of life.

verses.web: Whoever despises instruction will pay for it, but he who respects a command will be rewarded.
verses.kjv: Whoso despiseth the word shall be destroyed: but he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded.

verses.web: The teaching of the wise is a spring of life, to turn from the snares of death.
verses.kjv: The law of the wise is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.

verses.web: Good understanding wins favor; but the way of the unfaithful is hard.
verses.kjv: Good understanding giveth favour: but the way of transgressors is hard.

verses.web: Every prudent man acts from knowledge, but a fool exposes folly.
verses.kjv: Every prudent man dealeth with knowledge: but a fool layeth open his folly.

verses.web: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy gains healing.
verses.kjv: A wicked messenger falleth into mischief: but a faithful ambassador is health.

verses.web: Poverty and shame come to him who refuses discipline, but he who heeds correction shall be honored.
verses.kjv: Poverty and shame shall be to him that refuseth instruction: but he that regardeth reproof shall be honoured.

verses.web: Longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but fools detest turning from evil.
verses.kjv: The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul: but it is abomination to fools to depart from evil.

verses.web: One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.
verses.kjv: He that walketh with wise men shall be wise: but a companion of fools shall be destroyed.

verses.web: Misfortune pursues sinners, but prosperity rewards the righteous.
verses.kjv: Evil pursueth sinners: but to the righteous good shall be repayed.

verses.web: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.
verses.kjv: A good man leaveth an inheritance to his children’s children: and the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the just.

verses.web: An abundance of food is in poor people’s fields, but injustice sweeps it away.
verses.kjv: Much food is in the tillage of the poor: but there is that is destroyed for want of judgment.

verses.web: One who spares the rod hates his son, but one who loves him is careful to discipline him.
verses.kjv: He that spareth his rod hateth his son: but he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.

verses.web: The righteous one eats to the satisfying of his soul, but the belly of the wicked goes hungry.
verses.kjv: The righteous eateth to the satisfying of his soul: but the belly of the wicked shall want.

verses.web: Every wise woman builds her house, but the foolish one tears it down with her own hands.
verses.kjv: Every wise woman buildeth her house: but the foolish plucketh it down with her hands.

verses.web: He who walks in his uprightness fears Yahweh, but he who is perverse in his ways despises him.
verses.kjv: He that walketh in his uprightness feareth the Lord: but he that is perverse in his ways despiseth him.

verses.web: The fool’s talk brings a rod to his back, but the lips of the wise protect them.
verses.kjv: In the mouth of the foolish is a rod of pride: but the lips of the wise shall preserve them.

verses.web: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean, but much increase is by the strength of the ox.
verses.kjv: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean: but much increase is by the strength of the ox.

verses.web: A truthful witness will not lie, but a false witness pours out lies.
verses.kjv: A faithful witness will not lie: but a false witness will utter lies.

verses.web: A scoffer seeks wisdom, and doesn’t find it, but knowledge comes easily to a discerning person.
verses.kjv: A scorner seeketh wisdom, and findeth it not: but knowledge is easy unto him that understandeth.

verses.web: Stay away from a foolish man, for you won’t find knowledge on his lips.
verses.kjv: Go from the presence of a foolish man, when thou perceivest not in him the lips of knowledge.

verses.web: The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way, but the folly of fools is deceit.
verses.kjv: The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way: but the folly of fools is deceit.

verses.web: Fools mock at making atonement for sins, but among the upright there is good will.
verses.kjv: Fools make a mock at sin: but among the righteous there is favour.

verses.web: The heart knows its own bitterness and joy; he will not share these with a stranger.
verses.kjv: The heart knoweth his own bitterness; and a stranger doth not intermeddle with his joy.

verses.web: The house of the wicked will be overthrown, but the tent of the upright will flourish.
verses.kjv: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown: but the tabernacle of the upright shall flourish.

verses.web: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.
verses.kjv: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.

verses.web: Even in laughter the heart may be sorrowful, and mirth may end in heaviness.
verses.kjv: Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful; and the end of that mirth is heaviness.

verses.web: The unfaithful will be repaid for his own ways; likewise a good man will be rewarded for his ways.
verses.kjv: The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways: and a good man shall be satisfied from himself.

verses.web: A simple man believes everything, but the prudent man carefully considers his ways.
verses.kjv: The simple believeth every word: but the prudent man looketh well to his going.

verses.web: A wise man fears, and shuns evil, but the fool is hot headed and reckless.
verses.kjv: A wise man feareth, and departeth from evil: but the fool rageth, and is confident.

verses.web: He who is quick to become angry will commit folly, and a crafty man is hated.
verses.kjv: He that is soon angry dealeth foolishly: and a man of wicked devices is hated.

verses.web: The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
verses.kjv: The simple inherit folly: but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

verses.web: The evil bow down before the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
verses.kjv: The evil bow before the good; and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.

verses.web: The poor person is shunned even by his own neighbor, but the rich person has many friends.
verses.kjv: The poor is hated even of his own neighbour: but the rich hath many friends.

verses.web: He who despises his neighbor sins, but blessed is he who has pity on the poor.
verses.kjv: He that despiseth his neighbour sinneth: but he that hath mercy on the poor, happy is he.

verses.web: Don’t they go astray who plot evil? But love and faithfulness belong to those who plan good.
verses.kjv: Do they not err that devise evil? but mercy and truth shall be to them that devise good.

verses.web: In all hard work there is profit, but the talk of the lips leads only to poverty.
verses.kjv: In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury.

verses.web: The crown of the wise is their riches, but the folly of fools crowns them with folly.
verses.kjv: The crown of the wise is their riches: but the foolishness of fools is folly.

verses.web: A truthful witness saves souls, but a false witness is deceitful.
verses.kjv: A true witness delivereth souls: but a deceitful witness speaketh lies.

verses.web: In the fear of Yahweh is a secure fortress, and he will be a refuge for his children.
verses.kjv: In the fear of the Lord is strong confidence: and his children shall have a place of refuge.

verses.web: The fear of Yahweh is a fountain of life, turning people from the snares of death.
verses.kjv: The fear of the Lord is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.

verses.web: In the multitude of people is the king’s glory, but in the lack of people is the destruction of the prince.
verses.kjv: In the multitude of people is the king’s honour: but in the want of people is the destruction of the prince.

verses.web: He who is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a quick temper displays folly.
verses.kjv: He that is slow to wrath is of great understanding: but he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly.

verses.web: The life of the body is a heart at peace, but envy rots the bones.
verses.kjv: A sound heart is the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.

verses.web: He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for his Maker, but he who is kind to the needy honors him.
verses.kjv: He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker: but he that honoureth him hath mercy on the poor.

verses.web: The wicked is brought down in his calamity, but in death, the righteous has a refuge.
verses.kjv: The wicked is driven away in his wickedness: but the righteous hath hope in his death.

verses.web: Wisdom rests in the heart of one who has understanding, and is even made known in the inward part of fools.
verses.kjv: Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding: but that which is in the midst of fools is made known.

verses.web: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a disgrace to any people.
verses.kjv: Righteousness exalteth a nation: but sin is a reproach to any people.

verses.web: The king’s favor is toward a servant who deals wisely, but his wrath is toward one who causes shame.
verses.kjv: The king’s favour is toward a wise servant: but his wrath is against him that causeth shame.

verses.web: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
verses.kjv: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.

verses.web: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouth of fools gush out folly.
verses.kjv: The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright: but the mouth of fools poureth out foolishness.

verses.web: Yahweh’s eyes are everywhere, keeping watch on the evil and the good.
verses.kjv: The eyes of the Lord are in every place, beholding the evil and the good.

verses.web: A gentle tongue is a tree of life, but deceit in it crushes the spirit.
verses.kjv: A wholesome tongue is a tree of life: but perverseness therein is a breach in the spirit.

verses.web: A fool despises his father’s correction, but he who heeds reproof shows prudence.
verses.kjv: A fool despiseth his father’s instruction: but he that regardeth reproof is prudent.

verses.web: In the house of the righteous is much treasure, but the income of the wicked brings trouble.
verses.kjv: In the house of the righteous is much treasure: but in the revenues of the wicked is trouble.

verses.web: The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so with the heart of fools.
verses.kjv: The lips of the wise disperse knowledge: but the heart of the foolish doeth not so.

verses.web: The sacrifice made by the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh, but the prayer of the upright is his delight.
verses.kjv: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the Lord: but the prayer of the upright is his delight.
