verses.web: The way of the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh, but he loves him who follows after righteousness.
verses.kjv: The way of the wicked is an abomination unto the Lord: but he loveth him that followeth after righteousness.

verses.web: There is stern discipline for one who forsakes the way: whoever hates reproof shall die.
verses.kjv: Correction is grievous unto him that forsaketh the way: and he that hateth reproof shall die.

verses.web: Sheol and Abaddon are before Yahweh— how much more then the hearts of the children of men!
verses.kjv: Hell and destruction are before the Lord: how much more then the hearts of the children of men?

verses.web: A scoffer doesn’t love to be reproved; he will not go to the wise.
verses.kjv: A scorner loveth not one that reproveth him: neither will he go unto the wise.

verses.web: A glad heart makes a cheerful face; but an aching heart breaks the spirit.
verses.kjv: A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance: but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.

verses.web: The heart of one who has understanding seeks knowledge, but the mouths of fools feed on folly.
verses.kjv: The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge: but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness.

verses.web: All the days of the afflicted are wretched, but one who has a cheerful heart enjoys a continual feast.
verses.kjv: All the days of the afflicted are evil: but he that is of a merry heart hath a continual feast.

verses.web: Better is little, with the fear of Yahweh, than great treasure with trouble.
verses.kjv: Better is little with the fear of the Lord than great treasure and trouble therewith.

verses.web: Better is a dinner of herbs, where love is, than a fattened calf with hatred.
verses.kjv: Better is a dinner of herbs where love is, than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.

verses.web: A wrathful man stirs up contention, but one who is slow to anger appeases strife.
verses.kjv: A wrathful man stirreth up strife: but he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife.

verses.web: The way of the sluggard is like a thorn patch, but the path of the upright is a highway.
verses.kjv: The way of the slothful man is as an hedge of thorns: but the way of the righteous is made plain.

verses.web: A wise son makes a father glad, but a foolish man despises his mother.
verses.kjv: A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish man despiseth his mother.

verses.web: Folly is joy to one who is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding keeps his way straight.
verses.kjv: Folly is joy to him that is destitute of wisdom: but a man of understanding walketh uprightly.

verses.web: Where there is no counsel, plans fail; but in a multitude of counselors they are established.
verses.kjv: Without counsel purposes are disappointed: but in the multitude of counsellors they are established.

verses.web: Joy comes to a man with the reply of his mouth. How good is a word at the right time!
verses.kjv: A man hath joy by the answer of his mouth: and a word spoken in due season, how good is it!

verses.web: The path of life leads upward for the wise, to keep him from going downward to Sheol.
verses.kjv: The way of life is above to the wise, that he may depart from hell beneath.

verses.web: Yahweh will uproot the house of the proud, but he will keep the widow’s borders intact.
verses.kjv: The Lord will destroy the house of the proud: but he will establish the border of the widow.

verses.web: Yahweh detests the thoughts of the wicked, but the thoughts of the pure are pleasing.
verses.kjv: The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to the Lord: but the words of the pure are pleasant words.

verses.web: He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house, but he who hates bribes will live.
verses.kjv: He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house; but he that hateth gifts shall live.

verses.web: The heart of the righteous weighs answers, but the mouth of the wicked gushes out evil.
verses.kjv: The heart of the righteous studieth to answer: but the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things.

verses.web: Yahweh is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayer of the righteous.
verses.kjv: The Lord is far from the wicked: but he heareth the prayer of the righteous.

verses.web: The light of the eyes rejoices the heart. Good news gives health to the bones.
verses.kjv: The light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart: and a good report maketh the bones fat.

verses.web: The ear that listens to reproof lives, and will be at home among the wise.
verses.kjv: The ear that heareth the reproof of life abideth among the wise.

verses.web: He who refuses correction despises his own soul, but he who listens to reproof gets understanding.
verses.kjv: He that refuseth instruction despiseth his own soul: but he that heareth reproof getteth understanding.

verses.web: The fear of Yahweh teaches wisdom. Before honor is humility.
verses.kjv: The fear of the Lord is the instruction of wisdom; and before honour is humility.

verses.web: The plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from Yahweh.
verses.kjv: The preparations of the heart in man, and the answer of the tongue, is from the Lord.

verses.web: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but Yahweh weighs the motives.
verses.kjv: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but the Lord weigheth the spirits.

verses.web: Commit your deeds to Yahweh, and your plans shall succeed.
verses.kjv: Commit thy works unto the Lord, and thy thoughts shall be established.

verses.web: Yahweh has made everything for its own end— yes, even the wicked for the day of evil.
verses.kjv: The Lord hath made all things for himself: yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.

verses.web: Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to Yahweh: they shall certainly not be unpunished.
verses.kjv: Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to the Lord: though hand join in hand, he shall not be unpunished.

verses.web: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for. By the fear of Yahweh men depart from evil.
verses.kjv: By mercy and truth iniquity is purged: and by the fear of the Lord men depart from evil.

verses.web: When a man’s ways please Yahweh, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.
verses.kjv: When a man’s ways please the Lord, he maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.

verses.web: Better is a little with righteousness, than great revenues with injustice.
verses.kjv: Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right.

verses.web: A man’s heart plans his course, but Yahweh directs his steps.
verses.kjv: A man’s heart deviseth his way: but the Lord directeth his steps.

verses.web: Inspired judgments are on the lips of the king. He shall not betray his mouth.
verses.kjv: A divine sentence is in the lips of the king: his mouth transgresseth not in judgment.

verses.web: Honest balances and scales are Yahweh’s; all the weights in the bag are his work.
verses.kjv: A just weight and balance are the Lord’s: all the weights of the bag are his work.

verses.web: It is an abomination for kings to do wrong, for the throne is established by righteousness.
verses.kjv: It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness: for the throne is established by righteousness.

verses.web: Righteous lips are the delight of kings. They value one who speaks the truth.
verses.kjv: Righteous lips are the delight of kings; and they love him that speaketh right.

verses.web: The king’s wrath is a messenger of death, but a wise man will pacify it.
verses.kjv: The wrath of a king is as messengers of death: but a wise man will pacify it.

verses.web: In the light of the king’s face is life. His favor is like a cloud of the spring rain.
verses.kjv: In the light of the king’s countenance is life; and his favour is as a cloud of the latter rain.

verses.web: How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes, to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.
verses.kjv: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!

verses.web: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil. He who keeps his way preserves his soul.
verses.kjv: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil: he that keepeth his way preserveth his soul.

verses.web: Pride goes before destruction, and a haughty spirit before a fall.
verses.kjv: Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.

verses.web: It is better to be of a lowly spirit with the poor, than to divide the plunder with the proud.
verses.kjv: Better it is to be of an humble spirit with the lowly, than to divide the spoil with the proud.

verses.web: He who heeds the Word finds prosperity. Whoever trusts in Yahweh is blessed.
verses.kjv: He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good: and whoso trusteth in the Lord, happy is he.

verses.web: The wise in heart shall be called prudent. Pleasantness of the lips promotes instruction.
verses.kjv: The wise in heart shall be called prudent: and the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning.

verses.web: Understanding is a fountain of life to one who has it, but the punishment of fools is their folly.
verses.kjv: Understanding is a wellspring of life unto him that hath it: but the instruction of fools is folly.

verses.web: The heart of the wise instructs his mouth, and adds learning to his lips.
verses.kjv: The heart of the wise teacheth his mouth, and addeth learning to his lips.

verses.web: Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
verses.kjv: Pleasant words are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

verses.web: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.
verses.kjv: There is a way that seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.

verses.web: The appetite of the laboring man labors for him; for his mouth urges him on.
verses.kjv: He that laboureth laboureth for himself; for his mouth craveth it of him.

verses.web: A worthless man devises mischief. His speech is like a scorching fire.
verses.kjv: An ungodly man diggeth up evil: and in his lips there is as a burning fire.

verses.web: A perverse man stirs up strife. A whisperer separates close friends.
verses.kjv: A froward man soweth strife: and a whisperer separateth chief friends.

verses.web: A man of violence entices his neighbor, and leads him in a way that is not good.
verses.kjv: A violent man enticeth his neighbour, and leadeth him into the way that is not good.

verses.web: One who winks his eyes to plot perversities, one who compresses his lips, is bent on evil.
verses.kjv: He shutteth his eyes to devise froward things: moving his lips he bringeth evil to pass.

verses.web: Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.
verses.kjv: The hoary head is a crown of glory, if it be found in the way of righteousness.

verses.web: One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.
verses.kjv: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.

verses.web: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from Yahweh.
verses.kjv: The lot is cast into the lap; but the whole disposing thereof is of the Lord.

verses.web: Better is a dry morsel with quietness, than a house full of feasting with strife.
verses.kjv: Better is a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, than an house full of sacrifices with strife.

verses.web: A servant who deals wisely will rule over a son who causes shame, and shall have a part in the inheritance among the brothers.
verses.kjv: A wise servant shall have rule over a son that causeth shame, and shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren.

verses.web: The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold, but Yahweh tests the hearts.
verses.kjv: The fining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold: but the Lord trieth the hearts.

verses.web: An evildoer heeds wicked lips. A liar gives ear to a mischievous tongue.
verses.kjv: A wicked doer giveth heed to false lips; and a liar giveth ear to a naughty tongue.

verses.web: Whoever mocks the poor reproaches his Maker. He who is glad at calamity shall not be unpunished.
verses.kjv: Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker: and he that is glad at calamities shall not be unpunished.

verses.web: Children’s children are the crown of old men; the glory of children are their parents.
verses.kjv: Children’s children are the crown of old men; and the glory of children are their fathers.

verses.web: Arrogant speech isn’t fitting for a fool, much less do lying lips fit a prince.
verses.kjv: Excellent speech becometh not a fool: much less do lying lips a prince.

verses.web: A bribe is a precious stone in the eyes of him who gives it; wherever he turns, he prospers.
verses.kjv: A gift is as a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it: whithersoever it turneth, it prospereth.

verses.web: He who covers an offense promotes love; but he who repeats a matter separates best friends.
verses.kjv: He that covereth a transgression seeketh love; but he that repeateth a matter separateth very friends.

verses.web: A rebuke enters deeper into one who has understanding than a hundred lashes into a fool.
verses.kjv: A reproof entereth more into a wise man than an hundred stripes into a fool.

verses.web: An evil man seeks only rebellion; therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
verses.kjv: An evil man seeketh only rebellion: therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.

verses.web: Let a bear robbed of her cubs meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.
verses.kjv: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.

verses.web: Whoever rewards evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.
verses.kjv: Whoso rewardeth evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.

verses.web: The beginning of strife is like breaching a dam, therefore stop contention before quarreling breaks out.
verses.kjv: The beginning of strife is as when one letteth out water: therefore leave off contention, before it be meddled with.

verses.web: He who justifies the wicked, and he who condemns the righteous, both of them alike are an abomination to Yahweh.
verses.kjv: He that justifieth the wicked, and he that condemneth the just, even they both are abomination to the Lord.

verses.web: Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, since he has no understanding?
verses.kjv: Wherefore is there a price in the hand of a fool to get wisdom, seeing he hath no heart to it?

verses.web: A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.
verses.kjv: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.

verses.web: A man void of understanding strikes hands, and becomes collateral in the presence of his neighbor.
verses.kjv: A man void of understanding striketh hands, and becometh surety in the presence of his friend.

verses.web: He who loves disobedience loves strife. One who builds a high gate seeks destruction.
verses.kjv: He loveth transgression that loveth strife: and he that exalteth his gate seeketh destruction.

verses.web: One who has a perverse heart doesn’t find prosperity, and one who has a deceitful tongue falls into trouble.
verses.kjv: He that hath a froward heart findeth no good: and he that hath a perverse tongue falleth into mischief.

verses.web: He who becomes the father of a fool grieves. The father of a fool has no joy.
verses.kjv: He that begetteth a fool doeth it to his sorrow: and the father of a fool hath no joy.

verses.web: A cheerful heart makes good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.
verses.kjv: A merry heart doeth good like a medicine: but a broken spirit drieth the bones.

verses.web: A wicked man receives a bribe in secret, to pervert the ways of justice.
verses.kjv: A wicked man taketh a gift out of the bosom to pervert the ways of judgment.

verses.web: Wisdom is before the face of one who has understanding, but the eyes of a fool wander to the ends of the earth.
verses.kjv: Wisdom is before him that hath understanding; but the eyes of a fool are in the ends of the earth.

verses.web: A foolish son brings grief to his father, and bitterness to her who bore him.
verses.kjv: A foolish son is a grief to his father, and bitterness to her that bare him.

verses.web: Also to punish the righteous is not good, nor to flog officials for their integrity.
verses.kjv: Also to punish the just is not good, nor to strike princes for equity.

verses.web: He who spares his words has knowledge. He who is even tempered is a man of understanding.
verses.kjv: He that hath knowledge spareth his words: and a man of understanding is of an excellent spirit.

verses.web: Even a fool, when he keeps silent, is counted wise. When he shuts his lips, he is thought to be discerning.
verses.kjv: Even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted wise: and he that shutteth his lips is esteemed a man of understanding.

verses.web: An unfriendly man pursues selfishness, and defies all sound judgment.
verses.kjv: Through desire a man, having separated himself, seeketh and intermeddleth with all wisdom.

verses.web: A fool has no delight in understanding, but only in revealing his own opinion.
verses.kjv: A fool hath no delight in understanding, but that his heart may discover itself.

verses.web: When wickedness comes, contempt also comes, and with shame comes disgrace.
verses.kjv: When the wicked cometh, then cometh also contempt, and with ignominy reproach.

verses.web: The words of a man’s mouth are like deep waters. The fountain of wisdom is like a flowing brook.
verses.kjv: The words of a man’s mouth are as deep waters, and the wellspring of wisdom as a flowing brook.

verses.web: To be partial to the faces of the wicked is not good, nor to deprive the innocent of justice.
verses.kjv: It is not good to accept the person of the wicked, to overthrow the righteous in judgment.

verses.web: A fool’s lips come into strife, and his mouth invites beatings.
verses.kjv: A fool’s lips enter into contention, and his mouth calleth for strokes.

verses.web: A fool’s mouth is his destruction, and his lips are a snare to his soul.
verses.kjv: A fool’s mouth is his destruction, and his lips are the snare of his soul.

verses.web: The words of a gossip are like dainty morsels: they go down into a person’s innermost parts.
verses.kjv: The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.

verses.web: One who is slack in his work is brother to him who is a master of destruction.
verses.kjv: He also that is slothful in his work is brother to him that is a great waster.

verses.web: Yahweh’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.
verses.kjv: The name of the Lord is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.

verses.web: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, like an unscalable wall in his own imagination.
verses.kjv: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, and as an high wall in his own conceit.

verses.web: Before destruction the heart of man is proud, but before honor is humility.
verses.kjv: Before destruction the heart of man is haughty, and before honour is humility.

verses.web: He who gives answer before he hears, that is folly and shame to him.
verses.kjv: He that answereth a matter before he heareth it, it is folly and shame unto him.

verses.web: A man’s spirit will sustain him in sickness, but a crushed spirit, who can bear?
verses.kjv: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity; but a wounded spirit who can bear?

verses.web: The heart of the discerning gets knowledge. The ear of the wise seeks knowledge.
verses.kjv: The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge; and the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge.

verses.web: A man’s gift makes room for him, and brings him before great men.
verses.kjv: A man’s gift maketh room for him, and bringeth him before great men.

verses.web: He who pleads his cause first seems right; until another comes and questions him.
verses.kjv: He that is first in his own cause seemeth just; but his neighbour cometh and searcheth him.

verses.web: The lot settles disputes, and keeps strong ones apart.
verses.kjv: The lot causeth contentions to cease, and parteth between the mighty.

verses.web: A brother offended is more difficult than a fortified city; and disputes are like the bars of a castle.
verses.kjv: A brother offended is harder to be won than a strong city: and their contentions are like the bars of a castle.

verses.web: A man’s stomach is filled with the fruit of his mouth. With the harvest of his lips he is satisfied.
verses.kjv: A man’s belly shall be satisfied with the fruit of his mouth; and with the increase of his lips shall he be filled.

verses.web: Death and life are in the power of the tongue; those who love it will eat its fruit.
verses.kjv: Death and life are in the power of the tongue: and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.

verses.web: Whoever finds a wife finds a good thing, and obtains favor of Yahweh.
verses.kjv: Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing, and obtaineth favour of the Lord.

verses.web: The poor plead for mercy, but the rich answer harshly.
verses.kjv: The poor useth intreaties; but the rich answereth roughly.

verses.web: A man of many companions may be ruined, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.
verses.kjv: A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.

verses.web: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his lips and is a fool.
verses.kjv: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity, than he that is perverse in his lips, and is a fool.

verses.web: It isn’t good to have zeal without knowledge; nor being hasty with one’s feet and missing the way.
verses.kjv: Also, that the soul be without knowledge, it is not good; and he that hasteth with his feet sinneth.

verses.web: The foolishness of man subverts his way; his heart rages against Yahweh.
verses.kjv: The foolishness of man perverteth his way: and his heart fretteth against the Lord.

verses.web: Wealth adds many friends, but the poor is separated from his friend.
verses.kjv: Wealth maketh many friends; but the poor is separated from his neighbour.

verses.web: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who pours out lies shall not go free.
verses.kjv: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall not escape.

verses.web: Many will entreat the favor of a ruler, and everyone is a friend to a man who gives gifts.
verses.kjv: Many will intreat the favour of the prince: and every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts.

verses.web: All the relatives of the poor shun him: how much more do his friends avoid him! He pursues them with pleas, but they are gone.
verses.kjv: All the brethren of the poor do hate him: how much more do his friends go far from him? he pursueth them with words, yet they are wanting to him.

verses.web: He who gets wisdom loves his own soul. He who keeps understanding shall find good.
verses.kjv: He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul: he that keepeth understanding shall find good.

verses.web: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who utters lies shall perish.
verses.kjv: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall perish.

verses.web: Delicate living is not appropriate for a fool, much less for a servant to have rule over princes.
verses.kjv: Delight is not seemly for a fool; much less for a servant to have rule over princes.

verses.web: The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger. It is his glory to overlook an offense.
verses.kjv: The discretion of a man deferreth his anger; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression.

verses.web: The king’s wrath is like the roaring of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.
verses.kjv: The king’s wrath is as the roaring of a lion; but his favour is as dew upon the grass.

verses.web: A foolish son is the calamity of his father. A wife’s quarrels are a continual dripping.
verses.kjv: A foolish son is the calamity of his father: and the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping.

verses.web: House and riches are an inheritance from fathers, but a prudent wife is from Yahweh.
verses.kjv: House and riches are the inheritance of fathers: and a prudent wife is from the Lord.

verses.web: Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep. The idle soul shall suffer hunger.
verses.kjv: Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep; and an idle soul shall suffer hunger.

verses.web: He who keeps the commandment keeps his soul, but he who is contemptuous in his ways shall die.
verses.kjv: He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his own soul; but he that despiseth his ways shall die.

verses.web: He who has pity on the poor lends to Yahweh; he will reward him.
verses.kjv: He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the Lord; and that which he hath given will he pay him again.

verses.web: Discipline your son, for there is hope; don’t be a willing party to his death.
verses.kjv: Chasten thy son while there is hope, and let not thy soul spare for his crying.

verses.web: A hot-tempered man must pay the penalty, for if you rescue him, you must do it again.
verses.kjv: A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment: for if thou deliver him, yet thou must do it again.

verses.web: Listen to counsel and receive instruction, that you may be wise in your latter end.
verses.kjv: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end.

verses.web: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but Yahweh’s counsel will prevail.
verses.kjv: There are many devices in a man’s heart; nevertheless the counsel of the Lord, that shall stand.

verses.web: That which makes a man to be desired is his kindness. A poor man is better than a liar.
verses.kjv: The desire of a man is his kindness: and a poor man is better than a liar.

verses.web: The fear of Yahweh leads to life, then contentment; he rests and will not be touched by trouble.
verses.kjv: The fear of the Lord tendeth to life: and he that hath it shall abide satisfied; he shall not be visited with evil.

verses.web: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
verses.kjv: A slothful man hideth his hand in his bosom, and will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.

verses.web: Flog a scoffer, and the simple will learn prudence; rebuke one who has understanding, and he will gain knowledge.
verses.kjv: Smite a scorner, and the simple will beware: and reprove one that hath understanding, and he will understand knowledge.

verses.web: He who robs his father and drives away his mother, is a son who causes shame and brings reproach.
verses.kjv: He that wasteth his father, and chaseth away his mother, is a son that causeth shame, and bringeth reproach.

verses.web: If you stop listening to instruction, my son, you will stray from the words of knowledge.
verses.kjv: Cease, my son, to hear the instruction that causeth to err from the words of knowledge.

verses.web: A corrupt witness mocks justice, and the mouth of the wicked gulps down iniquity.
verses.kjv: An ungodly witness scorneth judgment: and the mouth of the wicked devoureth iniquity.

verses.web: Penalties are prepared for scoffers, and beatings for the backs of fools.
verses.kjv: Judgments are prepared for scorners, and stripes for the back of fools.

verses.web: Wine is a mocker, and beer is a brawler. Whoever is led astray by them is not wise.
verses.kjv: Wine is a mocker, strong drink is raging: and whosoever is deceived thereby is not wise.

verses.web: The terror of a king is like the roaring of a lion. He who provokes him to anger forfeits his own life.
verses.kjv: The fear of a king is as the roaring of a lion: whoso provoketh him to anger sinneth against his own soul.

verses.web: It is an honor for a man to keep aloof from strife; but every fool will be quarreling.
verses.kjv: It is an honour for a man to cease from strife: but every fool will be meddling.

verses.web: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the winter; therefore he shall beg in harvest, and have nothing.
verses.kjv: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the cold; therefore shall he beg in harvest, and have nothing.

verses.web: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water; but a man of understanding will draw it out.
verses.kjv: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water; but a man of understanding will draw it out.

verses.web: Many men claim to be men of unfailing love, but who can find a faithful man?
verses.kjv: Most men will proclaim every one his own goodness: but a faithful man who can find?

verses.web: A righteous man walks in integrity. Blessed are his children after him.
verses.kjv: The just man walketh in his integrity: his children are blessed after him.

verses.web: A king who sits on the throne of judgment scatters away all evil with his eyes.
verses.kjv: A king that sitteth in the throne of judgment scattereth away all evil with his eyes.

verses.web: Who can say, “I have made my heart pure. I am clean and without sin?”
verses.kjv: Who can say, I have made my heart clean, I am pure from my sin?

verses.web: Differing weights and differing measures, both of them alike are an abomination to Yahweh.
verses.kjv: Divers weights, and divers measures, both of them are alike abomination to the Lord.

verses.web: Even a child makes himself known by his doings, whether his work is pure, and whether it is right.
verses.kjv: Even a child is known by his doings, whether his work be pure, and whether it be right.

verses.web: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, Yahweh has made even both of them.
verses.kjv: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, the Lord hath made even both of them.

verses.web: Don’t love sleep, lest you come to poverty. Open your eyes, and you shall be satisfied with bread.
verses.kjv: Love not sleep, lest thou come to poverty; open thine eyes, and thou shalt be satisfied with bread.

verses.web: “It’s no good, it’s no good,” says the buyer; but when he is gone his way, then he boasts.
verses.kjv: It is naught, it is naught, saith the buyer: but when he is gone his way, then he boasteth.

verses.web: There is gold and abundance of rubies; but the lips of knowledge are a rare jewel.
verses.kjv: There is gold, and a multitude of rubies: but the lips of knowledge are a precious jewel.

verses.web: Take the garment of one who puts up collateral for a stranger; and hold him in pledge for a wayward woman.
verses.kjv: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger: and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.

verses.web: Fraudulent food is sweet to a man, but afterwards his mouth is filled with gravel.
verses.kjv: Bread of deceit is sweet to a man; but afterwards his mouth shall be filled with gravel.

verses.web: Plans are established by advice; by wise guidance you wage war!
verses.kjv: Every purpose is established by counsel: and with good advice make war.

verses.web: He who goes about as a tale-bearer reveals secrets; therefore don’t keep company with him who opens wide his lips.
verses.kjv: He that goeth about as a talebearer revealeth secrets: therefore meddle not with him that flattereth with his lips.

verses.web: Whoever curses his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in blackness of darkness.
verses.kjv: Whoso curseth his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in obscure darkness.

verses.web: An inheritance quickly gained at the beginning, won’t be blessed in the end.
verses.kjv: An inheritance may be gotten hastily at the beginning; but the end thereof shall not be blessed.

verses.web: Don’t say, “I will pay back evil.” Wait for Yahweh, and he will save you.
verses.kjv: Say not thou, I will recompense evil; but wait on the Lord, and he shall save thee.

verses.web: Yahweh detests differing weights, and dishonest scales are not pleasing.
verses.kjv: Divers weights are an abomination unto the Lord; and a false balance is not good.

verses.web: A man’s steps are from Yahweh; how then can man understand his way?
verses.kjv: Man’s goings are of the Lord; how can a man then understand his own way?

verses.web: It is a snare to a man to make a rash dedication, then later to consider his vows.
verses.kjv: It is a snare to the man who devoureth that which is holy, and after vows to make enquiry.

verses.web: A wise king winnows out the wicked, and drives the threshing wheel over them.
verses.kjv: A wise king scattereth the wicked, and bringeth the wheel over them.

verses.web: The spirit of man is Yahweh’s lamp, searching all his innermost parts.
verses.kjv: The spirit of man is the candle of the Lord, searching all the inward parts of the belly.

verses.web: Love and faithfulness keep the king safe. His throne is sustained by love.
verses.kjv: Mercy and truth preserve the king: and his throne is upholden by mercy.

verses.web: The glory of young men is their strength. The splendor of old men is their gray hair.
verses.kjv: The glory of young men is their strength: and the beauty of old men is the gray head.

verses.web: Wounding blows cleanse away evil, and beatings purge the innermost parts.
verses.kjv: The blueness of a wound cleanseth away evil: so do stripes the inward parts of the belly.

verses.web: The king’s heart is in Yahweh’s hand like the watercourses. He turns it wherever he desires.
verses.kjv: The king’s heart is in the hand of the Lord, as the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.

verses.web: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes, but Yahweh weighs the hearts.
verses.kjv: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes: but the Lord pondereth the hearts.

verses.web: To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to Yahweh than sacrifice.
verses.kjv: To do justice and judgment is more acceptable to the Lord than sacrifice.

verses.web: A high look, and a proud heart, the lamp of the wicked, is sin.
verses.kjv: An high look, and a proud heart, and the plowing of the wicked, is sin.

verses.web: The plans of the diligent surely lead to profit; and everyone who is hasty surely rushes to poverty.
verses.kjv: The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness; but of every one that is hasty only to want.

verses.web: Getting treasures by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor for those who seek death.
verses.kjv: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue is a vanity tossed to and fro of them that seek death.

verses.web: The violence of the wicked will drive them away, because they refuse to do what is right.
verses.kjv: The robbery of the wicked shall destroy them; because they refuse to do judgment.

verses.web: The way of the guilty is devious, but the conduct of the innocent is upright.
verses.kjv: The way of man is froward and strange: but as for the pure, his work is right.

verses.web: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop, than to share a house with a contentious woman.
verses.kjv: It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman in a wide house.

verses.web: The soul of the wicked desires evil; his neighbor finds no mercy in his eyes.
verses.kjv: The soul of the wicked desireth evil: his neighbour findeth no favour in his eyes.

verses.web: When the mocker is punished, the simple gains wisdom. When the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.
verses.kjv: When the scorner is punished, the simple is made wise: and when the wise is instructed, he receiveth knowledge.

verses.web: The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked, and brings the wicked to ruin.
verses.kjv: The righteous man wisely considereth the house of the wicked: but God overthroweth the wicked for their wickedness.

verses.web: Whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor, he will also cry out, but shall not be heard.
verses.kjv: Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor, he also shall cry himself, but shall not be heard.

verses.web: A gift in secret pacifies anger; and a bribe in the cloak, strong wrath.
verses.kjv: A gift in secret pacifieth anger: and a reward in the bosom strong wrath.

verses.web: It is joy to the righteous to do justice; but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.
verses.kjv: It is joy to the just to do judgment: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.

verses.web: The man who wanders out of the way of understanding shall rest in the assembly of the departed spirits.
verses.kjv: The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding shall remain in the congregation of the dead.

verses.web: He who loves pleasure shall be a poor man. He who loves wine and oil shall not be rich.
verses.kjv: He that loveth pleasure shall be a poor man: he that loveth wine and oil shall not be rich.

verses.web: The wicked is a ransom for the righteous; the treacherous for the upright.
verses.kjv: The wicked shall be a ransom for the righteous, and the transgressor for the upright.

verses.web: It is better to dwell in a desert land, than with a contentious and fretful woman.
verses.kjv: It is better to dwell in the wilderness, than with a contentious and an angry woman.

verses.web: There is precious treasure and oil in the dwelling of the wise; but a foolish man swallows it up.
verses.kjv: There is treasure to be desired and oil in the dwelling of the wise; but a foolish man spendeth it up.

verses.web: He who follows after righteousness and kindness finds life, righteousness, and honor.
verses.kjv: He that followeth after righteousness and mercy findeth life, righteousness, and honour.

verses.web: A wise man scales the city of the mighty, and brings down the strength of its confidence.
verses.kjv: A wise man scaleth the city of the mighty, and casteth down the strength of the confidence thereof.

verses.web: Whoever guards his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.
verses.kjv: Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue keepeth his soul from troubles.

verses.web: The proud and haughty man, “scoffer” is his name; he works in the arrogance of pride.
verses.kjv: Proud and haughty scorner is his name, who dealeth in proud wrath.

verses.web: The desire of the sluggard kills him, for his hands refuse to labor.
verses.kjv: The desire of the slothful killeth him; for his hands refuse to labour.

verses.web: There are those who covet greedily all day long; but the righteous give and don’t withhold.
verses.kjv: He coveteth greedily all the day long: but the righteous giveth and spareth not.

verses.web: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination: how much more, when he brings it with a wicked mind!
verses.kjv: The sacrifice of the wicked is abomination: how much more, when he bringeth it with a wicked mind?

verses.web: A false witness will perish, and a man who listens speaks to eternity.
verses.kjv: A false witness shall perish: but the man that heareth speaketh constantly.

verses.web: A wicked man hardens his face; but as for the upright, he establishes his ways.
verses.kjv: A wicked man hardeneth his face: but as for the upright, he directeth his way.

verses.web: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against Yahweh.
verses.kjv: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the Lord.

verses.web: The horse is prepared for the day of battle; but victory is with Yahweh.
verses.kjv: The horse is prepared against the day of battle: but safety is of the Lord.

verses.web: A good name is more desirable than great riches, and loving favor is better than silver and gold.
verses.kjv: A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches, and loving favour rather than silver and gold.

verses.web: The rich and the poor have this in common: Yahweh is the maker of them all.
verses.kjv: The rich and poor meet together: the Lord is the maker of them all.

verses.web: A prudent man sees danger, and hides himself; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.
verses.kjv: A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself: but the simple pass on, and are punished.

verses.web: The result of humility and the fear of Yahweh is wealth, honor, and life.
verses.kjv: By humility and the fear of the Lord are riches, and honour, and life.

verses.web: Thorns and snares are in the path of the wicked: whoever guards his soul stays from them.
verses.kjv: Thorns and snares are in the way of the froward: he that doth keep his soul shall be far from them.

verses.web: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.
verses.kjv: Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.

verses.web: The rich rule over the poor. The borrower is servant to the lender.
verses.kjv: The rich ruleth over the poor, and the borrower is servant to the lender.

verses.web: He who sows wickedness reaps trouble, and the rod of his fury will be destroyed.
verses.kjv: He that soweth iniquity shall reap vanity: and the rod of his anger shall fail.

verses.web: He who has a generous eye will be blessed; for he shares his food with the poor.
verses.kjv: He that hath a bountiful eye shall be blessed; for he giveth of his bread to the poor.

verses.web: Drive out the mocker, and strife will go out; yes, quarrels and insults will stop.
verses.kjv: Cast out the scorner, and contention shall go out; yea, strife and reproach shall cease.

verses.web: He who loves purity of heart and speaks gracefully is the king’s friend.
verses.kjv: He that loveth pureness of heart, for the grace of his lips the king shall be his friend.

verses.web: The eyes of Yahweh watch over knowledge; but he frustrates the words of the unfaithful.
verses.kjv: The eyes of the Lord preserve knowledge, and he overthroweth the words of the transgressor.

verses.web: The sluggard says, “There is a lion outside! I will be killed in the streets!”
verses.kjv: The slothful man saith, There is a lion without, I shall be slain in the streets.

verses.web: The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit: he who is under Yahweh’s wrath will fall into it.
verses.kjv: The mouth of strange women is a deep pit: he that is abhorred of the Lord shall fall therein.

verses.web: Folly is bound up in the heart of a child: the rod of discipline drives it far from him.
verses.kjv: Foolishness is bound in the heart of a child; but the rod of correction shall drive it far from him.

verses.web: Whoever oppresses the poor for his own increase and whoever gives to the rich, both come to poverty.
verses.kjv: He that oppresseth the poor to increase his riches, and he that giveth to the rich, shall surely come to want.

verses.web: Turn your ear, and listen to the words of the wise. Apply your heart to my teaching.
verses.kjv: Bow down thine ear, and hear the words of the wise, and apply thine heart unto my knowledge.

verses.web: For it is a pleasant thing if you keep them within you, if all of them are ready on your lips.
verses.kjv: For it is a pleasant thing if thou keep them within thee; they shall withal be fitted in thy lips.

verses.web: That your trust may be in Yahweh, I teach you today, even you.
verses.kjv: That thy trust may be in the Lord, I have made known to thee this day, even to thee.

verses.web: Haven’t I written to you thirty excellent things of counsel and knowledge,
verses.kjv: Have not I written to thee excellent things in counsels and knowledge,

verses.web: To teach you truth, reliable words, to give sound answers to the ones who sent you?
verses.kjv: That I might make thee know the certainty of the words of truth; that thou mightest answer the words of truth to them that send unto thee?

verses.web: Don’t exploit the poor, because he is poor; and don’t crush the needy in court;
verses.kjv: Rob not the poor, because he is poor: neither oppress the afflicted in the gate:

verses.web: for Yahweh will plead their case, and plunder the life of those who plunder them.
verses.kjv: For the Lord will plead their cause, and spoil the soul of those that spoiled them.

verses.web: Don’t befriend a hot-tempered man, and don’t associate with one who harbors anger:
verses.kjv: Make no friendship with an angry man; and with a furious man thou shalt not go:

verses.web: lest you learn his ways, and ensnare your soul.
verses.kjv: Lest thou learn his ways, and get a snare to thy soul.

verses.web: Don’t you be one of those who strike hands, of those who are collateral for debts.
verses.kjv: Be not thou one of them that strike hands, or of them that are sureties for debts.

verses.web: If you don’t have means to pay, why should he take away your bed from under you?
verses.kjv: If thou hast nothing to pay, why should he take away thy bed from under thee?

verses.web: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone, which your fathers have set up.
verses.kjv: Remove not the ancient landmark, which thy fathers have set.

verses.web: Do you see a man skilled in his work? He will serve kings. He won’t serve obscure men.
verses.kjv: Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before mean men.

verses.web: When you sit to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before you;
verses.kjv: When thou sittest to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before thee:

verses.web: put a knife to your throat, if you are a man given to appetite.
verses.kjv: And put a knife to thy throat, if thou be a man given to appetite.

verses.web: Don’t be desirous of his dainties, since they are deceitful food.
verses.kjv: Be not desirous of his dainties: for they are deceitful meat.

verses.web: Don’t weary yourself to be rich. In your wisdom, show restraint.
verses.kjv: Labour not to be rich: cease from thine own wisdom.

verses.web: Why do you set your eyes on that which is not? For it certainly sprouts wings like an eagle and flies in the sky.
verses.kjv: Wilt thou set thine eyes upon that which is not? for riches certainly make themselves wings; they fly away as an eagle toward heaven.

verses.web: Don’t eat the food of him who has a stingy eye, and don’t crave his delicacies:
verses.kjv: Eat thou not the bread of him that hath an evil eye, neither desire thou his dainty meats:

verses.web: for as he thinks about the cost, so he is. “Eat and drink!” he says to you, but his heart is not with you.
verses.kjv: For as he thinketh in his heart, so is he: Eat and drink, saith he to thee; but his heart is not with thee.

verses.web: The morsel which you have eaten you shall vomit up, and lose your good words.
verses.kjv: The morsel which thou hast eaten shalt thou vomit up, and lose thy sweet words.

verses.web: Don’t speak in the ears of a fool, for he will despise the wisdom of your words.
verses.kjv: Speak not in the ears of a fool: for he will despise the wisdom of thy words.

verses.web: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone. Don’t encroach on the fields of the fatherless:
verses.kjv: Remove not the old landmark; and enter not into the fields of the fatherless:

verses.web: for their Defender is strong. He will plead their case against you.
verses.kjv: For their redeemer is mighty; he shall plead their cause with thee.

verses.web: Apply your heart to instruction, and your ears to the words of knowledge.
verses.kjv: Apply thine heart unto instruction, and thine ears to the words of knowledge.

verses.web: Don’t withhold correction from a child. If you punish him with the rod, he will not die.
verses.kjv: Withhold not correction from the child: for if thou beatest him with the rod, he shall not die.

verses.web: Punish him with the rod, and save his soul from Sheol.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt beat him with the rod, and shalt deliver his soul from hell.

verses.web: My son, if your heart is wise, then my heart will be glad, even mine:
verses.kjv: My son, if thine heart be wise, my heart shall rejoice, even mine.

verses.web: yes, my heart will rejoice, when your lips speak what is right.
verses.kjv: Yea, my reins shall rejoice, when thy lips speak right things.

verses.web: Don’t let your heart envy sinners; but rather fear Yahweh all the day long.
verses.kjv: Let not thine heart envy sinners: but be thou in the fear of the Lord all the day long.

verses.web: Indeed surely there is a future hope, and your hope will not be cut off.
verses.kjv: For surely there is an end; and thine expectation shall not be cut off.

verses.web: Listen, my son, and be wise, and keep your heart on the right path!
verses.kjv: Hear thou, my son, and be wise, and guide thine heart in the way.

verses.web: Don’t be among ones drinking too much wine, or those who gorge themselves on meat:
verses.kjv: Be not among winebibbers; among riotous eaters of flesh:

verses.web: for the drunkard and the glutton shall become poor; and drowsiness clothes them in rags.
verses.kjv: For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty: and drowsiness shall clothe a man with rags.

verses.web: Listen to your father who gave you life, and don’t despise your mother when she is old.
verses.kjv: Hearken unto thy father that begat thee, and despise not thy mother when she is old.

verses.web: Buy the truth, and don’t sell it. Get wisdom, discipline, and understanding.
verses.kjv: Buy the truth, and sell it not; also wisdom, and instruction, and understanding.

verses.web: The father of the righteous has great joy. Whoever fathers a wise child delights in him.
verses.kjv: The father of the righteous shall greatly rejoice: and he that begetteth a wise child shall have joy of him.

verses.web: Let your father and your mother be glad! Let her who bore you rejoice!
verses.kjv: Thy father and thy mother shall be glad, and she that bare thee shall rejoice.

verses.web: My son, give me your heart; and let your eyes keep in my ways.
verses.kjv: My son, give me thine heart, and let thine eyes observe my ways.

verses.web: For a prostitute is a deep pit; and a wayward wife is a narrow well.
verses.kjv: For a whore is a deep ditch; and a strange woman is a narrow pit.

verses.web: Yes, she lies in wait like a robber, and increases the unfaithful among men.
verses.kjv: She also lieth in wait as for a prey, and increaseth the transgressors among men.

verses.web: Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has strife? Who has complaints? Who has needless bruises? Who has bloodshot eyes?
verses.kjv: Who hath woe? who hath sorrow? who hath contentions? who hath babbling? who hath wounds without cause? who hath redness of eyes?

verses.web: Those who stay long at the wine; those who go to seek out mixed wine.
verses.kjv: They that tarry long at the wine; they that go to seek mixed wine.

verses.web: Don’t look at the wine when it is red, when it sparkles in the cup, when it goes down smoothly.
verses.kjv: Look not thou upon the wine when it is red, when it giveth his colour in the cup, when it moveth itself aright.

verses.web: In the end, it bites like a snake, and poisons like a viper.
verses.kjv: At the last it biteth like a serpent, and stingeth like an adder.

verses.web: Your eyes will see strange things, and your mind will imagine confusing things.
verses.kjv: Thine eyes shall behold strange women, and thine heart shall utter perverse things.

verses.web: Yes, you will be as he who lies down in the midst of the sea, or as he who lies on top of the rigging:
verses.kjv: Yea, thou shalt be as he that lieth down in the midst of the sea, or as he that lieth upon the top of a mast.

verses.web: “They hit me, and I was not hurt! They beat me, and I don’t feel it! When will I wake up? I can do it again. I can find another.”
verses.kjv: They have stricken me, shalt thou say, and I was not sick; they have beaten me, and I felt it not: when shall I awake? I will seek it yet again.

verses.web: Don’t be envious of evil men; neither desire to be with them:
verses.kjv: Be not thou envious against evil men, neither desire to be with them.

verses.web: for their hearts plot violence, and their lips talk about mischief.
verses.kjv: For their heart studieth destruction, and their lips talk of mischief.

verses.web: Through wisdom a house is built; by understanding it is established;
verses.kjv: Through wisdom is an house builded; and by understanding it is established:

verses.web: by knowledge the rooms are filled with all rare and beautiful treasure.
verses.kjv: And by knowledge shall the chambers be filled with all precious and pleasant riches.

verses.web: A wise man has great power; and a knowledgeable man increases strength;
verses.kjv: A wise man is strong; yea, a man of knowledge increaseth strength.

verses.web: for by wise guidance you wage your war; and victory is in many advisors.
verses.kjv: For by wise counsel thou shalt make thy war: and in multitude of counsellors there is safety.

verses.web: Wisdom is too high for a fool: he doesn’t open his mouth in the gate.
verses.kjv: Wisdom is too high for a fool: he openeth not his mouth in the gate.

verses.web: One who plots to do evil will be called a schemer.
verses.kjv: He that deviseth to do evil shall be called a mischievous person.

verses.web: The schemes of folly are sin. The mocker is detested by men.
verses.kjv: The thought of foolishness is sin: and the scorner is an abomination to men.

verses.web: If you falter in the time of trouble, your strength is small.
verses.kjv: If thou faint in the day of adversity, thy strength is small.

verses.web: Rescue those who are being led away to death! Indeed, hold back those who are staggering to the slaughter!
verses.kjv: If thou forbear to deliver them that are drawn unto death, and those that are ready to be slain;

verses.web: If you say, “Behold, we didn’t know this”; doesn’t he who weighs the hearts consider it? He who keeps your soul, doesn’t he know it? Shall he not render to every man according to his work?
verses.kjv: If thou sayest, Behold, we knew it not; doth not he that pondereth the heart consider it? and he that keepeth thy soul, doth not he know it? and shall not he render to every man according to his works?

verses.web: My son, eat honey, for it is good; the droppings of the honeycomb, which are sweet to your taste:
verses.kjv: My son, eat thou honey, because it is good; and the honeycomb, which is sweet to thy taste:

verses.web: so you shall know wisdom to be to your soul; if you have found it, then there will be a reward, your hope will not be cut off.
verses.kjv: So shall the knowledge of wisdom be unto thy soul: when thou hast found it, then there shall be a reward, and thy expectation shall not be cut off.

verses.web: Don’t lay in wait, wicked man, against the habitation of the righteous. Don’t destroy his resting place:
verses.kjv: Lay not wait, O wicked man, against the dwelling of the righteous; spoil not his resting place:

verses.web: for a righteous man falls seven times, and rises up again; but the wicked are overthrown by calamity.
verses.kjv: For a just man falleth seven times, and riseth up again: but the wicked shall fall into mischief.

verses.web: Don’t rejoice when your enemy falls. Don’t let your heart be glad when he is overthrown;
verses.kjv: Rejoice not when thine enemy falleth, and let not thine heart be glad when he stumbleth:

verses.web: lest Yahweh see it, and it displease him, and he turn away his wrath from him.
verses.kjv: Lest the Lord see it, and it displease him, and he turn away his wrath from him.

verses.web: Don’t fret yourself because of evildoers; neither be envious of the wicked:
verses.kjv: Fret not thyself because of evil men, neither be thou envious at the wicked;

verses.web: for there will be no reward to the evil man; and the lamp of the wicked shall be snuffed out.
verses.kjv: For there shall be no reward to the evil man; the candle of the wicked shall be put out.

verses.web: My son, fear Yahweh and the king. Don’t join those who are rebellious:
verses.kjv: My son, fear thou the Lord and the king: and meddle not with them that are given to change:

verses.web: for their calamity will rise suddenly; the destruction from them both—who knows?
verses.kjv: For their calamity shall rise suddenly; and who knoweth the ruin of them both?

verses.web: These also are sayings of the wise. To show partiality in judgment is not good.
verses.kjv: These things also belong to the wise. It is not good to have respect of persons in judgment.

verses.web: He who says to the wicked, “You are righteous”; peoples shall curse him, and nations shall abhor him—
verses.kjv: He that saith unto the wicked, Thou art righteous; him shall the people curse, nations shall abhor him:

verses.web: but it will go well with those who convict the guilty, and a rich blessing will come on them.
verses.kjv: But to them that rebuke him shall be delight, and a good blessing shall come upon them.

verses.web: An honest answer is like a kiss on the lips.
verses.kjv: Every man shall kiss his lips that giveth a right answer.

verses.web: Prepare your work outside, and get your fields ready. Afterwards, build your house.
verses.kjv: Prepare thy work without, and make it fit for thyself in the field; and afterwards build thine house.

verses.web: Don’t be a witness against your neighbor without cause. Don’t deceive with your lips.
verses.kjv: Be not a witness against thy neighbour without cause; and deceive not with thy lips.

verses.web: Don’t say, “I will do to him as he has done to me; I will render to the man according to his work.”
verses.kjv: Say not, I will do so to him as he hath done to me: I will render to the man according to his work.

verses.web: I went by the field of the sluggard, by the vineyard of the man void of understanding;
verses.kjv: I went by the field of the slothful, and by the vineyard of the man void of understanding;

verses.web: Behold, it was all grown over with thorns. Its surface was covered with nettles, and its stone wall was broken down.
verses.kjv: And, lo, it was all grown over with thorns, and nettles had covered the face thereof, and the stone wall thereof was broken down.

verses.web: Then I saw, and considered well. I saw, and received instruction:
verses.kjv: Then I saw, and considered it well: I looked upon it, and received instruction.

verses.web: a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep;
verses.kjv: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:

verses.web: so your poverty will come as a robber, and your want as an armed man.
verses.kjv: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth; and thy want as an armed man.

verses.web: These also are proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.
verses.kjv: These are also proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.

verses.web: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing, but the glory of kings is to search out a matter.
verses.kjv: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing: but the honour of kings is to search out a matter.

verses.web: As the heavens for height, and the earth for depth, so the hearts of kings are unsearchable.
verses.kjv: The heaven for height, and the earth for depth, and the heart of kings is unsearchable.

verses.web: Take away the dross from the silver, and material comes out for the refiner;
verses.kjv: Take away the dross from the silver, and there shall come forth a vessel for the finer.

verses.web: Take away the wicked from the king’s presence, and his throne will be established in righteousness.
verses.kjv: Take away the wicked from before the king, and his throne shall be established in righteousness.

verses.web: Don’t exalt yourself in the presence of the king, or claim a place among great men;
verses.kjv: Put not forth thyself in the presence of the king, and stand not in the place of great men:

verses.web: for it is better that it be said to you, “Come up here,” than that you should be put lower in the presence of the prince, whom your eyes have seen.
verses.kjv: For better it is that it be said unto thee, Come up hither; than that thou shouldest be put lower in the presence of the prince whom thine eyes have seen.

verses.web: Don’t be hasty in bringing charges to court. What will you do in the end when your neighbor shames you?
verses.kjv: Go not forth hastily to strive, lest thou know not what to do in the end thereof, when thy neighbour hath put thee to shame.

verses.web: Debate your case with your neighbor, and don’t betray the confidence of another;
verses.kjv: Debate thy cause with thy neighbour himself; and discover not a secret to another:

verses.web: lest one who hears it put you to shame, and your bad reputation never depart.
verses.kjv: Lest he that heareth it put thee to shame, and thine infamy turn not away.

verses.web: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver.
verses.kjv: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in pictures of silver.

verses.web: As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover to an obedient ear.
verses.kjv: As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover upon an obedient ear.

verses.web: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to those who send him; for he refreshes the soul of his masters.
verses.kjv: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to them that send him: for he refresheth the soul of his masters.

verses.web: As clouds and wind without rain, so is he who boasts of gifts deceptively.
verses.kjv: Whoso boasteth himself of a false gift is like clouds and wind without rain.

verses.web: By patience a ruler is persuaded. A soft tongue breaks the bone.
verses.kjv: By long forbearing is a prince persuaded, and a soft tongue breaketh the bone.

verses.web: Have you found honey? Eat as much as is sufficient for you, lest you eat too much, and vomit it.
verses.kjv: Hast thou found honey? eat so much as is sufficient for thee, lest thou be filled therewith, and vomit it.

verses.web: Let your foot be seldom in your neighbor’s house, lest he be weary of you, and hate you.
verses.kjv: Withdraw thy foot from thy neighbour’s house; lest he be weary of thee, and so hate thee.

verses.web: A man who gives false testimony against his neighbor is like a club, a sword, or a sharp arrow.
verses.kjv: A man that beareth false witness against his neighbour is a maul, and a sword, and a sharp arrow.

verses.web: Confidence in someone unfaithful in time of trouble is like a bad tooth, or a lame foot.
verses.kjv: Confidence in an unfaithful man in time of trouble is like a broken tooth, and a foot out of joint.

verses.web: As one who takes away a garment in cold weather, or vinegar on soda, so is one who sings songs to a heavy heart.
verses.kjv: As he that taketh away a garment in cold weather, and as vinegar upon nitre, so is he that singeth songs to an heavy heart.

verses.web: If your enemy is hungry, give him food to eat. If he is thirsty, give him water to drink:
verses.kjv: If thine enemy be hungry, give him bread to eat; and if he be thirsty, give him water to drink:

verses.web: for you will heap coals of fire on his head, and Yahweh will reward you.
verses.kjv: For thou shalt heap coals of fire upon his head, and the Lord shall reward thee.

verses.web: The north wind produces rain: so a backbiting tongue brings an angry face.
verses.kjv: The north wind driveth away rain: so doth an angry countenance a backbiting tongue.

verses.web: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop, than to share a house with a contentious woman.
verses.kjv: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman and in a wide house.

verses.web: Like cold water to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.
verses.kjv: As cold waters to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.

verses.web: Like a muddied spring, and a polluted well, so is a righteous man who gives way before the wicked.
verses.kjv: A righteous man falling down before the wicked is as a troubled fountain, and a corrupt spring.

verses.web: It is not good to eat much honey; nor is it honorable to seek one’s own honor.
verses.kjv: It is not good to eat much honey: so for men to search their own glory is not glory.

verses.web: Like a city that is broken down and without walls is a man whose spirit is without restraint.
verses.kjv: He that hath no rule over his own spirit is like a city that is broken down, and without walls.

verses.web: Like snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, so honor is not fitting for a fool.
verses.kjv: As snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, so honour is not seemly for a fool.

verses.web: Like a fluttering sparrow, like a darting swallow, so the undeserved curse doesn’t come to rest.
verses.kjv: As the bird by wandering, as the swallow by flying, so the curse causeless shall not come.

verses.web: A whip is for the horse, a bridle for the donkey, and a rod for the back of fools!
verses.kjv: A whip for the horse, a bridle for the ass, and a rod for the fool’s back.

verses.web: Don’t answer a fool according to his folly, lest you also be like him.
verses.kjv: Answer not a fool according to his folly, lest thou also be like unto him.

verses.web: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own eyes.
verses.kjv: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own conceit.

verses.web: One who sends a message by the hand of a fool is cutting off feet and drinking violence.
verses.kjv: He that sendeth a message by the hand of a fool cutteth off the feet, and drinketh damage.

verses.web: Like the legs of the lame that hang loose: so is a parable in the mouth of fools.
verses.kjv: The legs of the lame are not equal: so is a parable in the mouth of fools.

verses.web: As one who binds a stone in a sling, so is he who gives honor to a fool.
verses.kjv: As he that bindeth a stone in a sling, so is he that giveth honour to a fool.

verses.web: Like a thorn bush that goes into the hand of a drunkard, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.
verses.kjv: As a thorn goeth up into the hand of a drunkard, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.

verses.web: As an archer who wounds all, so is he who hires a fool or he who hires those who pass by.
verses.kjv: The great God that formed all things both rewardeth the fool, and rewardeth transgressors.

verses.web: As a dog that returns to his vomit, so is a fool who repeats his folly.
verses.kjv: As a dog returneth to his vomit, so a fool returneth to his folly.

verses.web: Do you see a man wise in his own eyes? There is more hope for a fool than for him.
verses.kjv: Seest thou a man wise in his own conceit? there is more hope of a fool than of him.

verses.web: The sluggard says, “There is a lion in the road! A fierce lion roams the streets!”
verses.kjv: The slothful man saith, There is a lion in the way; a lion is in the streets.

verses.web: As the door turns on its hinges, so does the sluggard on his bed.
verses.kjv: As the door turneth upon his hinges, so doth the slothful upon his bed.

verses.web: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish. He is too lazy to bring it back to his mouth.
verses.kjv: The slothful hideth his hand in his bosom; it grieveth him to bring it again to his mouth.

verses.web: The sluggard is wiser in his own eyes than seven men who answer with discretion.
verses.kjv: The sluggard is wiser in his own conceit than seven men that can render a reason.

verses.web: Like one who grabs a dog’s ears is one who passes by and meddles in a quarrel not his own.
verses.kjv: He that passeth by, and meddleth with strife belonging not to him, is like one that taketh a dog by the ears.

verses.web: Like a madman who shoots torches, arrows, and death,
verses.kjv: As a mad man who casteth firebrands, arrows, and death,

verses.web: is the man who deceives his neighbor and says, “Am I not joking?”
verses.kjv: So is the man that deceiveth his neighbour, and saith, Am not I in sport?

verses.web: For lack of wood a fire goes out. Without gossip, a quarrel dies down.
verses.kjv: Where no wood is, there the fire goeth out: so where there is no talebearer, the strife ceaseth.

verses.web: As coals are to hot embers, and wood to fire, so is a contentious man to kindling strife.
verses.kjv: As coals are to burning coals, and wood to fire; so is a contentious man to kindle strife.

verses.web: The words of a whisperer are as dainty morsels, they go down into the innermost parts.
verses.kjv: The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.

verses.web: Like silver dross on an earthen vessel are the lips of a fervent one with an evil heart.
verses.kjv: Burning lips and a wicked heart are like a potsherd covered with silver dross.

verses.web: A malicious man disguises himself with his lips, but he harbors evil in his heart.
verses.kjv: He that hateth dissembleth with his lips, and layeth up deceit within him;

verses.web: When his speech is charming, don’t believe him; for there are seven abominations in his heart.
verses.kjv: When he speaketh fair, believe him not: for there are seven abominations in his heart.

verses.web: His malice may be concealed by deception, but his wickedness will be exposed in the assembly.
verses.kjv: Whose hatred is covered by deceit, his wickedness shall be shewed before the whole congregation.

verses.web: Whoever digs a pit shall fall into it. Whoever rolls a stone, it will come back on him.
verses.kjv: Whoso diggeth a pit shall fall therein: and he that rolleth a stone, it will return upon him.

verses.web: A lying tongue hates those it hurts; and a flattering mouth works ruin.
verses.kjv: A lying tongue hateth those that are afflicted by it; and a flattering mouth worketh ruin.

verses.web: Don’t boast about tomorrow; for you don’t know what a day may bring.
verses.kjv: Boast not thyself of to morrow; for thou knowest not what a day may bring forth.

verses.web: Let another man praise you, and not your own mouth; a stranger, and not your own lips.
verses.kjv: Let another man praise thee, and not thine own mouth; a stranger, and not thine own lips.

verses.web: A stone is heavy, and sand is a burden; but a fool’s provocation is heavier than both.
verses.kjv: A stone is heavy, and the sand weighty; but a fool’s wrath is heavier than them both.

verses.web: Wrath is cruel, and anger is overwhelming; but who is able to stand before jealousy?
verses.kjv: Wrath is cruel, and anger is outrageous; but who is able to stand before envy?

verses.web: Better is open rebuke than hidden love.
verses.kjv: Open rebuke is better than secret love.

verses.web: Faithful are the wounds of a friend; although the kisses of an enemy are profuse.
verses.kjv: Faithful are the wounds of a friend; but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.

verses.web: A full soul loathes a honeycomb; but to a hungry soul, every bitter thing is sweet.
verses.kjv: The full soul loatheth an honeycomb; but to the hungry soul every bitter thing is sweet.

verses.web: As a bird that wanders from her nest, so is a man who wanders from his home.
verses.kjv: As a bird that wandereth from her nest, so is a man that wandereth from his place.

verses.web: Perfume and incense bring joy to the heart; so does earnest counsel from a man’s friend.
verses.kjv: Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart: so doth the sweetness of a man’s friend by hearty counsel.

verses.web: Don’t forsake your friend and your father’s friend. Don’t go to your brother’s house in the day of your disaster: better is a neighbor who is near than a distant brother.
verses.kjv: Thine own friend, and thy father’s friend, forsake not; neither go into thy brother’s house in the day of thy calamity: for better is a neighbour that is near than a brother far off.

verses.web: Be wise, my son, and bring joy to my heart, then I can answer my tormentor.
verses.kjv: My son, be wise, and make my heart glad, that I may answer him that reproacheth me.

verses.web: A prudent man sees danger and takes refuge; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.
verses.kjv: A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself; but the simple pass on, and are punished.

verses.web: Take his garment when he puts up collateral for a stranger. Hold it for a wayward woman!
verses.kjv: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger, and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.

verses.web: He who blesses his neighbor with a loud voice early in the morning, it will be taken as a curse by him.
verses.kjv: He that blesseth his friend with a loud voice, rising early in the morning, it shall be counted a curse to him.

verses.web: A continual dropping on a rainy day and a contentious wife are alike:
verses.kjv: A continual dropping in a very rainy day and a contentious woman are alike.

verses.web: restraining her is like restraining the wind, or like grasping oil in his right hand.
verses.kjv: Whosoever hideth her hideth the wind, and the ointment of his right hand, which bewrayeth itself.

verses.web: Iron sharpens iron; so a man sharpens his friend’s countenance.
verses.kjv: Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.

verses.web: Whoever tends the fig tree shall eat its fruit. He who looks after his master shall be honored.
verses.kjv: Whoso keepeth the fig tree shall eat the fruit thereof: so he that waiteth on his master shall be honoured.

verses.web: Like water reflects a face, so a man’s heart reflects the man.
verses.kjv: As in water face answereth to face, so the heart of man to man.

verses.web: Sheol and Abaddon are never satisfied; and a man’s eyes are never satisfied.
verses.kjv: Hell and destruction are never full; so the eyes of man are never satisfied.

verses.web: The crucible is for silver, and the furnace for gold; but man is refined by his praise.
verses.kjv: As the fining pot for silver, and the furnace for gold; so is a man to his praise.

verses.web: Though you grind a fool in a mortar with a pestle along with grain, yet his foolishness will not be removed from him.
verses.kjv: Though thou shouldest bray a fool in a mortar among wheat with a pestle, yet will not his foolishness depart from him.

verses.web: Know well the state of your flocks, and pay attention to your herds:
verses.kjv: Be thou diligent to know the state of thy flocks, and look well to thy herds.

verses.web: for riches are not forever, nor does even the crown endure to all generations.
verses.kjv: For riches are not for ever: and doth the crown endure to every generation?

verses.web: The hay is removed, and the new growth appears, the grasses of the hills are gathered in.
verses.kjv: The hay appeareth, and the tender grass sheweth itself, and herbs of the mountains are gathered.

verses.web: The lambs are for your clothing, and the goats are the price of a field.
verses.kjv: The lambs are for thy clothing, and the goats are the price of the field.

verses.web: There will be plenty of goats’ milk for your food, for your family’s food, and for the nourishment of your servant girls.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt have goats’ milk enough for thy food, for the food of thy household, and for the maintenance for thy maidens.

verses.web: The wicked flee when no one pursues; but the righteous are as bold as a lion.
verses.kjv: The wicked flee when no man pursueth: but the righteous are bold as a lion.

verses.web: In rebellion, a land has many rulers, but order is maintained by a man of understanding and knowledge.
verses.kjv: For the transgression of a land many are the princes thereof: but by a man of understanding and knowledge the state thereof shall be prolonged.

verses.web: A needy man who oppresses the poor is like a driving rain which leaves no crops.
verses.kjv: A poor man that oppresseth the poor is like a sweeping rain which leaveth no food.

verses.web: Those who forsake the law praise the wicked; but those who keep the law contend with them.
verses.kjv: They that forsake the law praise the wicked: but such as keep the law contend with them.

verses.web: Evil men don’t understand justice; but those who seek Yahweh understand it fully.
verses.kjv: Evil men understand not judgment: but they that seek the Lord understand all things.

verses.web: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity, than he who is perverse in his ways, and he is rich.
verses.kjv: Better is the poor that walketh in his uprightness, than he that is perverse in his ways, though he be rich.

verses.web: Whoever keeps the law is a wise son; but he who is a companion of gluttons shames his father.
verses.kjv: Whoso keepeth the law is a wise son: but he that is a companion of riotous men shameth his father.

verses.web: He who increases his wealth by excessive interest gathers it for one who has pity on the poor.
verses.kjv: He that by usury and unjust gain increaseth his substance, he shall gather it for him that will pity the poor.

verses.web: He who turns away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer is an abomination.
verses.kjv: He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer shall be abomination.

verses.web: Whoever causes the upright to go astray in an evil way, he will fall into his own trap; but the blameless will inherit good.
verses.kjv: Whoso causeth the righteous to go astray in an evil way, he shall fall himself into his own pit: but the upright shall have good things in possession.

verses.web: The rich man is wise in his own eyes; but the poor who has understanding sees through him.
verses.kjv: The rich man is wise in his own conceit; but the poor that hath understanding searcheth him out.

verses.web: When the righteous triumph, there is great glory; but when the wicked rise, men hide themselves.
verses.kjv: When righteous men do rejoice, there is great glory: but when the wicked rise, a man is hidden.

verses.web: He who conceals his sins doesn’t prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.
verses.kjv: He that covereth his sins shall not prosper: but whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall have mercy.

verses.web: Blessed is the man who always fears; but one who hardens his heart falls into trouble.
verses.kjv: Happy is the man that feareth alway: but he that hardeneth his heart shall fall into mischief.

verses.web: As a roaring lion or a charging bear, so is a wicked ruler over helpless people.
verses.kjv: As a roaring lion, and a ranging bear; so is a wicked ruler over the poor people.

verses.web: A tyrannical ruler lacks judgment. One who hates ill-gotten gain will have long days.
verses.kjv: The prince that wanteth understanding is also a great oppressor: but he that hateth covetousness shall prolong his days.

verses.web: A man who is tormented by life blood will be a fugitive until death; no one will support him.
verses.kjv: A man that doeth violence to the blood of any person shall flee to the pit; let no man stay him.

verses.web: Whoever walks blamelessly is kept safe; but one with perverse ways will fall suddenly.
verses.kjv: Whoso walketh uprightly shall be saved: but he that is perverse in his ways shall fall at once.

verses.web: One who works his land will have an abundance of food; but one who chases fantasies will have his fill of poverty.
verses.kjv: He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread: but he that followeth after vain persons shall have poverty enough.

verses.web: A faithful man is rich with blessings; but one who is eager to be rich will not go unpunished.
verses.kjv: A faithful man shall abound with blessings: but he that maketh haste to be rich shall not be innocent.

verses.web: To show partiality is not good; yet a man will do wrong for a piece of bread.
