verses.kjv: To have respect of persons is not good: for for a piece of bread that man will transgress.

verses.web: A stingy man hurries after riches, and doesn’t know that poverty waits for him.
verses.kjv: He that hasteth to be rich hath an evil eye, and considereth not that poverty shall come upon him.

verses.web: One who rebukes a man will afterward find more favor than one who flatters with the tongue.
verses.kjv: He that rebuketh a man afterwards shall find more favour than he that flattereth with the tongue.

verses.web: Whoever robs his father or his mother, and says, “It’s not wrong.” He is a partner with a destroyer.
verses.kjv: Whoso robbeth his father or his mother, and saith, It is no transgression; the same is the companion of a destroyer.

verses.web: One who is greedy stirs up strife; but one who trusts in Yahweh will prosper.
verses.kjv: He that is of a proud heart stirreth up strife: but he that putteth his trust in the Lord shall be made fat.

verses.web: One who trusts in himself is a fool; but one who walks in wisdom is kept safe.
verses.kjv: He that trusteth in his own heart is a fool: but whoso walketh wisely, he shall be delivered.

verses.web: One who gives to the poor has no lack; but one who closes his eyes will have many curses.
verses.kjv: He that giveth unto the poor shall not lack: but he that hideth his eyes shall have many a curse.

verses.web: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves; but when they perish, the righteous thrive.
verses.kjv: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves: but when they perish, the righteous increase.

verses.web: He who is often rebuked and stiffens his neck will be destroyed suddenly, with no remedy.
verses.kjv: He, that being often reproved hardeneth his neck, shall suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.

verses.web: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; but when the wicked rule, the people groan.
verses.kjv: When the righteous are in authority, the people rejoice: but when the wicked beareth rule, the people mourn.

verses.web: Whoever loves wisdom brings joy to his father; but a companion of prostitutes squanders his wealth.
verses.kjv: Whoso loveth wisdom rejoiceth his father: but he that keepeth company with harlots spendeth his substance.

verses.web: The king by justice makes the land stable, but he who takes bribes tears it down.
verses.kjv: The king by judgment establisheth the land: but he that receiveth gifts overthroweth it.

verses.web: A man who flatters his neighbor spreads a net for his feet.
verses.kjv: A man that flattereth his neighbour spreadeth a net for his feet.

verses.web: An evil man is snared by his sin, but the righteous can sing and be glad.
verses.kjv: In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare: but the righteous doth sing and rejoice.

verses.web: The righteous care about justice for the poor. The wicked aren’t concerned about knowledge.
verses.kjv: The righteous considereth the cause of the poor: but the wicked regardeth not to know it.

verses.web: Mockers stir up a city, but wise men turn away anger.
verses.kjv: Scornful men bring a city into a snare: but wise men turn away wrath.

verses.web: If a wise man goes to court with a foolish man, the fool rages or scoffs, and there is no peace.
verses.kjv: If a wise man contendeth with a foolish man, whether he rage or laugh, there is no rest.

verses.web: The bloodthirsty hate a man of integrity; and they seek the life of the upright.
verses.kjv: The bloodthirsty hate the upright: but the just seek his soul.

verses.web: A fool vents all of his anger, but a wise man brings himself under control.
verses.kjv: A fool uttereth all his mind: but a wise man keepeth it in till afterwards.

verses.web: If a ruler listens to lies, all of his officials are wicked.
verses.kjv: If a ruler hearken to lies, all his servants are wicked.

verses.web: The poor man and the oppressor have this in common: Yahweh gives sight to the eyes of both.
verses.kjv: The poor and the deceitful man meet together: the Lord lighteneth both their eyes.

verses.web: The king who fairly judges the poor, his throne shall be established forever.
verses.kjv: The king that faithfully judgeth the poor, his throne shall be established for ever.

verses.web: The rod of correction gives wisdom, but a child left to himself causes shame to his mother.
verses.kjv: The rod and reproof give wisdom: but a child left to himself bringeth his mother to shame.

verses.web: When the wicked increase, sin increases; but the righteous will see their downfall.
verses.kjv: When the wicked are multiplied, transgression increaseth: but the righteous shall see their fall.

verses.web: Correct your son, and he will give you peace; yes, he will bring delight to your soul.
verses.kjv: Correct thy son, and he shall give thee rest; yea, he shall give delight unto thy soul.

verses.web: Where there is no revelation, the people cast off restraint; but one who keeps the law is blessed.
verses.kjv: Where there is no vision, the people perish: but he that keepeth the law, happy is he.

verses.web: A servant can’t be corrected by words. Though he understands, yet he will not respond.
verses.kjv: A servant will not be corrected by words: for though he understand he will not answer.

verses.web: Do you see a man who is hasty in his words? There is more hope for a fool than for him.
verses.kjv: Seest thou a man that is hasty in his words? there is more hope of a fool than of him.

verses.web: He who pampers his servant from youth will have him become a son in the end.
verses.kjv: He that delicately bringeth up his servant from a child shall have him become his son at the length.

verses.web: An angry man stirs up strife, and a wrathful man abounds in sin.
verses.kjv: An angry man stirreth up strife, and a furious man aboundeth in transgression.

verses.web: A man’s pride brings him low, but one of lowly spirit gains honor.
verses.kjv: A man’s pride shall bring him low: but honour shall uphold the humble in spirit.

verses.web: Whoever is an accomplice of a thief is an enemy of his own soul. He takes an oath, but dares not testify.
verses.kjv: Whoso is partner with a thief hateth his own soul: he heareth cursing, and bewrayeth it not.

verses.web: The fear of man proves to be a snare, but whoever puts his trust in Yahweh is kept safe.
verses.kjv: The fear of man bringeth a snare: but whoso putteth his trust in the Lord shall be safe.

verses.web: Many seek the ruler’s favor, but a man’s justice comes from Yahweh.
verses.kjv: Many seek the ruler’s favour; but every man’s judgment cometh from the Lord.

verses.web: A dishonest man detests the righteous, and the upright in their ways detest the wicked.
verses.kjv: An unjust man is an abomination to the just: and he that is upright in the way is abomination to the wicked.

verses.web: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, the oracle: the man says to Ithiel, to Ithiel and Ucal:
verses.kjv: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, even the prophecy: the man spake unto Ithiel, even unto Ithiel and Ucal,

verses.web: “Surely I am the most ignorant man, and don’t have a man’s understanding.
verses.kjv: Surely I am more brutish than any man, and have not the understanding of a man.

verses.web: I have not learned wisdom, neither do I have the knowledge of the Holy One.
verses.kjv: I neither learned wisdom, nor have the knowledge of the holy.

verses.web: Who has ascended up into heaven, and descended? Who has gathered the wind in his fists? Who has bound the waters in his garment? Who has established all the ends of the earth? What is his name, and what is his son’s name, if you know?
verses.kjv: Who hath ascended up into heaven, or descended? who hath gathered the wind in his fists? who hath bound the waters in a garment? who hath established all the ends of the earth? what is his name, and what is his son’s name, if thou canst tell?

verses.web: “Every word of God is flawless. He is a shield to those who take refuge in him.
verses.kjv: Every word of God is pure: he is a shield unto them that put their trust in him.

verses.web: Don’t you add to his words, lest he reprove you, and you be found a liar.
verses.kjv: Add thou not unto his words, lest he reprove thee, and thou be found a liar.

verses.web: “Two things I have asked of you; don’t deny me before I die:
verses.kjv: Two things have I required of thee; deny me them not before I die:

verses.web: Remove far from me falsehood and lies. Give me neither poverty nor riches. Feed me with the food that is needful for me;
verses.kjv: Remove far from me vanity and lies: give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with food convenient for me:

verses.web: lest I be full, deny you, and say, ‘Who is Yahweh?’ or lest I be poor, and steal, and so dishonor the name of my God.
verses.kjv: Lest I be full, and deny thee, and say, Who is the Lord? or lest I be poor, and steal, and take the name of my God in vain.

verses.web: “Don’t slander a servant to his master, lest he curse you, and you be held guilty.
verses.kjv: Accuse not a servant unto his master, lest he curse thee, and thou be found guilty.

verses.web: There is a generation that curses their father, and doesn’t bless their mother.
verses.kjv: There is a generation that curseth their father, and doth not bless their mother.

verses.web: There is a generation that is pure in their own eyes, yet are not washed from their filthiness.
verses.kjv: There is a generation that are pure in their own eyes, and yet is not washed from their filthiness.

verses.web: There is a generation, oh how lofty are their eyes! Their eyelids are lifted up.
verses.kjv: There is a generation, O how lofty are their eyes! and their eyelids are lifted up.

verses.web: There is a generation whose teeth are like swords, and their jaws like knives, to devour the poor from the earth, and the needy from among men.
verses.kjv: There is a generation, whose teeth are as swords, and their jaw teeth as knives, to devour the poor from off the earth, and the needy from among men.

verses.web: “The leach has two daughters: ‘Give, give.’ “There are three things that are never satisfied; four that don’t say, ‘Enough:’
verses.kjv: The horseleach hath two daughters, crying, Give, give. There are three things that are never satisfied, yea, four things say not, It is enough:

verses.web: Sheol, the barren womb; the earth that is not satisfied with water; and the fire that doesn’t say, ‘Enough.’
verses.kjv: The grave; and the barren womb; the earth that is not filled with water; and the fire that saith not, It is enough.

verses.web: “The eye that mocks at his father, and scorns obedience to his mother: the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, the young eagles shall eat it.
verses.kjv: The eye that mocketh at his father, and despiseth to obey his mother, the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, and the young eagles shall eat it.

verses.web: “There are three things which are too amazing for me, four which I don’t understand:
verses.kjv: There be three things which are too wonderful for me, yea, four which I know not:

verses.web: The way of an eagle in the air; the way of a serpent on a rock; the way of a ship in the midst of the sea; and the way of a man with a maiden.
verses.kjv: The way of an eagle in the air; the way of a serpent upon a rock; the way of a ship in the midst of the sea; and the way of a man with a maid.

verses.web: “So is the way of an adulterous woman: she eats and wipes her mouth, and says, ‘I have done nothing wrong.’
verses.kjv: Such is the way of an adulterous woman; she eateth, and wipeth her mouth, and saith, I have done no wickedness.

verses.web: “For three things the earth tremble, and under four, it can’t bear up:
verses.kjv: For three things the earth is disquieted, and for four which it cannot bear:

verses.web: For a servant when he is king; a fool when he is filled with food;
verses.kjv: For a servant when he reigneth; and a fool when he is filled with meat;

verses.web: for an unloved woman when she is married; and a handmaid who is heir to her mistress.
verses.kjv: For an odious woman when she is married; and an handmaid that is heir to her mistress.

verses.web: “There are four things which are little on the earth, but they are exceedingly wise:
verses.kjv: There be four things which are little upon the earth, but they are exceeding wise:

verses.web: the ants are not a strong people, yet they provide their food in the summer.
verses.kjv: The ants are a people not strong, yet they prepare their meat in the summer;

verses.web: The conies are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks.
verses.kjv: The conies are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks;

verses.web: The locusts have no king, yet they advance in ranks.
verses.kjv: The locusts have no king, yet go they forth all of them by bands;

verses.web: You can catch a lizard with your hands, yet it is in kings’ palaces.
verses.kjv: The spider taketh hold with her hands, and is in kings’ palaces.

verses.web: “There are three things which are stately in their march, four which are stately in going:
verses.kjv: There be three things which go well, yea, four are comely in going:

verses.web: The lion, which is mightiest among animals, and doesn’t turn away for any;
verses.kjv: A lion which is strongest among beasts, and turneth not away for any;

verses.web: the greyhound, the male goat also; and the king against whom there is no rising up.
verses.kjv: A greyhound; an he goat also; and a king, against whom there is no rising up.

verses.web: “If you have done foolishly in lifting up yourself, or if you have thought evil, put your hand over your mouth.
verses.kjv: If thou hast done foolishly in lifting up thyself, or if thou hast thought evil, lay thine hand upon thy mouth.

verses.web: For as the churning of milk produces butter, and the wringing of the nose produces blood; so the forcing of wrath produces strife.”
verses.kjv: Surely the churning of milk bringeth forth butter, and the wringing of the nose bringeth forth blood: so the forcing of wrath bringeth forth strife.

verses.web: The words of king Lemuel; the oracle which his mother taught him.
verses.kjv: The words of king Lemuel, the prophecy that his mother taught him.

verses.web: “Oh, my son! Oh, son of my womb! Oh, son of my vows!
verses.kjv: What, my son? and what, the son of my womb? and what, the son of my vows?

verses.web: Don’t give your strength to women, nor your ways to that which destroys kings.
verses.kjv: Give not thy strength unto women, nor thy ways to that which destroyeth kings.

verses.web: It is not for kings, Lemuel; it is not for kings to drink wine; nor for princes to say, ‘Where is strong drink?’
verses.kjv: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine; nor for princes strong drink:

verses.web: lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the justice due to anyone who is afflicted.
verses.kjv: Lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the judgment of any of the afflicted.

verses.web: Give strong drink to him who is ready to perish; and wine to the bitter in soul:
verses.kjv: Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish, and wine unto those that be of heavy hearts.

verses.web: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.
verses.kjv: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.

verses.web: Open your mouth for the mute, in the cause of all who are left desolate.
verses.kjv: Open thy mouth for the dumb in the cause of all such as are appointed to destruction.

verses.web: Open your mouth, judge righteously, and serve justice to the poor and needy.”
verses.kjv: Open thy mouth, judge righteously, and plead the cause of the poor and needy.

verses.web: Who can find a worthy woman? For her price is far above rubies.
verses.kjv: Who can find a virtuous woman? for her price is far above rubies.

verses.web: The heart of her husband trusts in her. He shall have no lack of gain.
verses.kjv: The heart of her husband doth safely trust in her, so that he shall have no need of spoil.

verses.web: She does him good, and not harm, all the days of her life.
verses.kjv: She will do him good and not evil all the days of her life.

verses.web: She seeks wool and flax, and works eagerly with her hands.
verses.kjv: She seeketh wool, and flax, and worketh willingly with her hands.

verses.web: She is like the merchant ships. She brings her bread from afar.
verses.kjv: She is like the merchants’ ships; she bringeth her food from afar.

verses.web: She rises also while it is yet night, gives food to her household, and portions for her servant girls.
verses.kjv: She riseth also while it is yet night, and giveth meat to her household, and a portion to her maidens.

verses.web: She considers a field, and buys it. With the fruit of her hands, she plants a vineyard.
verses.kjv: She considereth a field, and buyeth it: with the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard.

verses.web: She arms her waist with strength, and makes her arms strong.
verses.kjv: She girdeth her loins with strength, and strengtheneth her arms.

verses.web: She perceives that her merchandise is profitable. Her lamp doesn’t go out by night.
verses.kjv: She perceiveth that her merchandise is good: her candle goeth not out by night.

verses.web: She lays her hands to the distaff, and her hands hold the spindle.
verses.kjv: She layeth her hands to the spindle, and her hands hold the distaff.

verses.web: She opens her arms to the poor; yes, she extends her hands to the needy.
verses.kjv: She stretcheth out her hand to the poor; yea, she reacheth forth her hands to the needy.

verses.web: She is not afraid of the snow for her household; for all her household are clothed with scarlet.
verses.kjv: She is not afraid of the snow for her household: for all her household are clothed with scarlet.

verses.web: She makes for herself carpets of tapestry. Her clothing is fine linen and purple.
verses.kjv: She maketh herself coverings of tapestry; her clothing is silk and purple.

verses.web: Her husband is respected in the gates, when he sits among the elders of the land.
verses.kjv: Her husband is known in the gates, when he sitteth among the elders of the land.

verses.web: She makes linen garments and sells them, and delivers sashes to the merchant.
verses.kjv: She maketh fine linen, and selleth it; and delivereth girdles unto the merchant.

verses.web: Strength and dignity are her clothing. She laughs at the time to come.
verses.kjv: Strength and honour are her clothing; and she shall rejoice in time to come.

verses.web: She opens her mouth with wisdom. Faithful instruction is on her tongue.
verses.kjv: She openeth her mouth with wisdom; and in her tongue is the law of kindness.

verses.web: She looks well to the ways of her household, and doesn’t eat the bread of idleness.
verses.kjv: She looketh well to the ways of her household, and eateth not the bread of idleness.

verses.web: Her children rise up and call her blessed. Her husband also praises her:
verses.kjv: Her children arise up, and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praiseth her.

verses.web: “Many women do noble things, but you excel them all.”
verses.kjv: Many daughters have done virtuously, but thou excellest them all.

verses.web: Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain; but a woman who fears Yahweh, she shall be praised.
verses.kjv: Favour is deceitful, and beauty is vain: but a woman that feareth the Lord, she shall be praised.

verses.web: Give her of the fruit of her hands! Let her works praise her in the gates!
verses.kjv: Give her of the fruit of her hands; and let her own works praise her in the gates.
